archetypeEssence.en: The raw flash of creative fire—an unmistakable impulse asking to be seized before it cools.
archetypeEssence.zh: 破云而出的第一簇创造之火——趁热抓住那道清晰冲动，而非等它冷却。

en: Luminous hand emerging from a bright cloud grasping a single upright wand
Fresh green leaves sprouting from the wooden staff and drifting through the air
Distant stone castle perched on sunlit hills beyond a winding river
Open valley landscape signaling fertile ground for a new venture
zh: 自云端伸出、稳稳握住一根竖直权杖的明亮之手
自木杖抽芽并随风飘落的翠绿嫩叶
蜿蜒河流远方山丘上的石造城堡
开阔肥沃的山谷风景，象征新计划的生长沃土

en: Luminous ivory hand emerging from a backlit midnight-and-amber cloud holding one upright flowering bronze-and-wood wand
Exactly one sculpted sprouting wand crowned with emerald leaves and floating golden sparks
Warm vermilion-gold sunburst radiating behind the wand against velvety midnight-indigo sky
Distant lantern-lit hilltop castle above a silver-gilded winding river valley
zh: 自琥珀背光夜云中伸出、高举一根发芽权杖的月白之手
清晰唯一的一根古铜鎏金木杖，枝头抽芽并伴随飘散金星
在深邃午夜靛蓝天幕中绽开的暖朱砂与琥珀日芒
远方银金河流与山谷尽头亮着暖灯的高丘城堡

core.en: Ace of Wands marks a genuine surge of inspiration, appetite, and creative will. A seed of fire has landed in your hand—act on the spark while it is alive rather than waiting for a complete blueprint.
core.zh: 权杖王牌代表真切涌现的灵感、热情与行动力。一粒火种已经落进你掌心——趁它炽热时立刻动手点燃，不必等到蓝图分毫不差。

message.en: Say yes to the idea that makes your pulse quicken; momentum begins the moment you give this spark a real first shape.
message.zh: 回应那个让你心跳加速的念头；只要你给这簇火花一个真实雏形，势头就会立刻启动。

foundation.en: This chapter began with a sudden burst of enthusiasm, a bold pitch, or a creative urge that refused to stay quiet.
foundation.zh: 整件事的起点源于一次突发的热情、大胆提议，或按捺不住的创作与行动冲动。

present.en: Fresh energy is available right now—clear the desk and channel it into one tangible beginning before distractions scatter it.
present.zh: 眼下正有一股饱满的新鲜动能——清出桌面，趁杂事分心前把它灌进一个具体的开端里。

challenge.en: Excitement on its own can outrun follow-through: a bright start with nothing to hold it. Pair the ignition with one concrete anchor.
challenge.zh: 光有兴头容易虎头蛇尾，开场很亮却没有东西托住——给这股冲劲配上一个落地锚点。

resource.en: Your strongest asset is raw drive and originality; people respond to visible conviction far more than polished caution.
resource.zh: 你手头最强的筹码是纯粹干劲与原创锐气；看得见的笃定感，往往比滴水不漏的谨慎更能打动人。

action.en: Build the rough draft, book the first session, or launch the pilot today while the creative heat is high.
action.zh: 趁热打铁：今天就把粗样做出来、约下第一场会或启动试点，别让热情在观望中熄火。

outcome.en: If you keep feeding this spark, a lively new venture, creative breakthrough, or revitalized sense of purpose is likely to take root with room to grow.
outcome.zh: 若持续为这簇火花添柴，一个充满生命力的新项目、一次创作突破或重新点燃的目标感很可能生根，并留有宽广的成长空间。

advice.en: Protect the new flame from premature cynicism; let it become real before you judge its final size.
advice.zh: 先护住这簇刚燃起的火苗，别用过早的挑剔泼冷水；先让它成形，再谈规模。

hidden.en: Check whether a want you have not said out loud is already steering your choices. The urge to begin something may be stronger than the “passing whim” you keep calling it.
hidden.zh: 留意那个你还没说出口的念头，是否已在悄悄左右你的选择。想要开始的冲动，也许比你口中的“一时兴起”强烈得多。

self.en: You come to this as the one holding the spark: keen, a little impatient, and more ready to begin than your careful talk about timing suggests.
self.zh: 在这件事里，你是手握火种的那个人：跃跃欲试，有点等不及，其实比嘴上反复掂量时机的样子更想动手。

other.en: The other person appears to arrive with fresh enthusiasm and a concrete proposal. They are likely ready to start quickly, so watch whether their follow-up matches the opening burst.
other.zh: 对方看起来是带着新鲜的热情和具体的提议来的，很可能想马上开始；不妨观察这股开场的劲头之后，有没有行动跟上。

external.en: Conditions favor beginnings: a door has opened, people around you are receptive to new proposals, and the ground is fertile even though nothing has been built on it yet.
external.zh: 外部环境正利于开局：机会的门已经打开，周围的人对新提议也乐于接受；这片土地足够肥沃，只是上面还什么都没建。

hopes_fears.en: You hope this spark is the real thing, the start you have been waiting for, yet fear that acting on it will expose it as a flash that fades by next week.
hopes_fears.zh: 你盼着这簇火花是真的，是你等了很久的那个开端；又怕一旦动手，才发现它不过是撑不过几天的三分钟热度。

general.en: A bold creative spark and fresh wave of inspiration are ready to be acted upon. Seize the opening with decisive energy and give your impulse a real starting point.
general.zh: 一股鲜活的灵感与创造火种正递到你手边。趁热情饱满时果断迈出第一步，把脑中的念头尽快变成看得见的现实起点。

love.en: In love, Ace of Wands brings magnetic attraction, renewed passion, or an exciting fresh chapter. Initiate warmly and let genuine desire show without over-rehearsing.
love.zh: 在感情中，权杖王牌带来强烈吸引、重新升温的火花或令人振奋的新阶段。大方主动表达热情，不必把真挚心意藏在反复试探后。

career.en: At work, this is green-light energy for a new role, side venture, or bold initiative. Pitch the idea, ship a quick prototype, and claim early ownership.
career.zh: 在工作与事业上，这是开启新岗位、新业务或大胆提案的绿灯信号。尽快拿出原型或提案，趁势抢占先发主动权。

health.en: Vitality is rising—channel this burst of energy into invigorating movement, a fresh routine, or an active goal that makes you feel genuinely alive.
health.zh: 在身心状态上，生命力与精力正在回升——把这股充沛劲头投入到让你感到畅快的运动、新习惯或充满活力的日常节奏中。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, Ace of Wands is the creative life-force waking up: honor curiosity and passion as sacred fuel rather than distractions from discipline.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，权杖王牌象征内在生命之火的苏醒：把热忱与好奇当作滋养成长的纯净燃料，而不是需要压抑的浮躁杂念。

core.en: Ace of Wands reversed points to a stalled ignition—delays, low creative fuel, or an idea still looking for the right timing and focus before it can catch fire.
core.zh: 权杖王牌逆位指向尚未点着的火种——推进延迟、热情受阻，或一个好念头还在等待更合适的时机与聚焦点。

blocked.en: Creative frustration or external delays are keeping a promising start stuck on the runway.
blocked.zh: 创作卡壳或外部延误，让原本有潜力的开端暂时停在起跑线上。

excess.en: Chasing five impulsive sparks at once and burning out before any single one catches.
excess.zh: 同时追逐好几个冲动念头，结果精力散尽却没点着其中任何一个。

internalized.en: A quiet desire is gestating beneath the surface; it needs private incubation before public launch.
internalized.zh: 一份真实的渴望正在水下酝酿，公开亮相前还需要一段安静的孵化期。

release.en: Letting go of a forced passion project that no longer excites you so real energy can return.
release.zh: 放下那个已经不再让你兴奋的勉强念头，把心力腾给真正能点燃你的方向。

message.en: The spark is not dead, only unlit. Stop judging yourself for the delay and find out what it is missing: timing, rest, or a narrower target.
message.zh: 火种没有熄灭，只是还没点着。别再为拖延责怪自己，先弄清它缺的是什么：时机、休息，还是一个更窄的目标。

foundation.en: A start that never quite caught sits behind this: a plan launched too early, enthusiasm spread over too many ideas, or a project you kept pushing after the thrill had gone.
foundation.zh: 这件事的背后，是一次没能真正点着的开头：计划启动得太早，热情摊在了太多念头上，或是兴头过去之后还在硬推的项目。

present.en: Right now the engine turns over without catching. You have the idea but not the fuel or the opening, and pushing harder mostly produces frustration.
present.zh: 眼下就像发动机转了半天却打不着火：想法是有的，缺的是燃料或一个入口；越使劲硬推，换来的越是烦躁。

challenge.en: False starts, hesitation, or scattered enthusiasm are draining the spark before it can build momentum.
challenge.zh: 反复试探、拖延观望或过于分散的热情，正在把火苗在成势之前耗散掉。

resource.en: What you can use is the pause itself: an idea kept out of the spotlight has time to mature, and you now know which of your many sparks still tugs at you after the excitement fades.
resource.zh: 可以利用的正是这段停顿：没急着亮相的想法有时间慢慢成熟，而你也看清了，兴奋退去之后还在牵动你的是哪一个念头。

action.en: Clear one bottleneck, pick a single small experiment, and restart without demanding instant fireworks.
action.zh: 先疏通眼下最卡的一个堵点，只挑一件小事重新动手，不必强求一上来就轰轰烈烈。

outcome.en: The launch is likely to slow for a while; used well, that pause is a chance to refine direction so the eventual start actually holds.
outcome.zh: 启动节奏多半会暂时放缓；用好这段停顿去校准方向，后续真正起步时才站得住。

advice.en: Don't force enthusiasm by willpower alone—rest, narrow your focus, and wait for the click of genuine interest.
advice.zh: 别靠硬逼自己来制造热情——先歇口气、收窄焦点，等真正契合的兴趣重新亮起来。

hidden.en: Ask whether the delay is really about circumstances. A quiet loss of interest, or a desire you have not admitted to, may be doing more to stall this than any outside obstacle.
hidden.zh: 不妨问问自己，卡住真的只是因为客观条件吗？悄悄流失的兴趣，或是一个你还不愿承认的渴望，也许比任何外部阻碍都更拖进度。

self.en: You are showing up half-committed: interested enough to keep the idea around, not yet convinced enough to give it a real start, and somewhat hard on yourself about the gap.
self.zh: 你在这件事里只投入了一半：兴趣足以让你舍不得放下这个想法，信心却还不够让你真正开头，同时又为这段落差暗暗苛责自己。

other.en: For now they may be slow to respond or lukewarm. Their interest appears real but unfocused, so an early show of eagerness on their side is unlikely to turn into action just yet.
other.zh: 对方目前可能回应迟缓，或者态度不冷不热；看上去兴趣是真的，只是还没聚焦，所以他们一开始的热络未必会很快变成行动。

external.en: Outside timing is not cooperating: approvals lag, replies come late, or the window you wanted has not opened. These delays sit in the environment and say little about the idea's worth.
external.zh: 外部时机暂时不配合：审批拖着，回复姗姗来迟，或者你等的那个窗口还没打开。这些延误出在环境上，并不说明想法本身不行。

hopes_fears.en: Part of you hopes the missing drive will return so you can begin properly; another part fears the truth is that you have lost interest, or that the moment has already passed.
hopes_fears.zh: 你一边盼着那股劲头自己回来，好让你正经开始；一边又怕真相是你已经没了兴趣，或者最好的时机早已错过。

general.en: Delays or blocked passion ask you to pause and check whether the timing, energy, or scope needs recalibration before pushing forward.
general.zh: 权杖王牌逆位提示推进延迟或热情受阻，适合先停下来检查时机、精力储备或切入范围，等重新对齐后再发力。

love.en: In relationships, reversed Ace of Wands reflects lukewarm timing, hesitant chemistry, or routine dulling the spark. Bring small honest novelty instead of forcing drama.
love.zh: 在感情中，权杖王牌逆位反映互动略显温吞、犹豫观望或日常磨淡了火花。用真诚的小新鲜感慢慢回温，别靠制造波折找刺激。

career.en: At work, a launch may stall or motivation may dip around an uninspiring brief. Clarify the core problem before pouring fresh hours into a false start.
career.zh: 在工作上，项目可能遭遇延期，或对缺乏共鸣的任务提不起劲。先厘清真正值得投入的核心目标，避免在错误方向上空转。

health.en: Low stamina or restless fatigue signals depleted reserves; replenish sleep and baseline energy before taking on ambitious new physical goals.
health.zh: 在身心状态上，精力不足或焦躁乏力说明底层储备偏低；先补足睡眠与基础恢复，再谈开启高强度的新计划。

spirituality.en: A dry spell in inspiration is not failure; quiet fallow seasons gather the quiet tinder for your next authentic calling.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，灵感暂歇并非退步；安静的休耕期正是在暗中积蓄火绒，为下一轮真正由衷的召唤做好准备。

promptSpec.suitAccent: warm sunlit amber-vermilion, copper-bronze, sprouting emerald leaves, molten antique gold, luminous warm ivory
promptSpec.scene: A luminous ivory-skinned hand emerging gracefully from a glowing golden-rimmed midnight cloud on the right, firmly gripping EXACTLY ONE tall, straight, carved bronze-and-wood wand held upright in the center of the composition. Fresh emerald-green leaves sprout vigorously along the wand's shaft while several detached golden-edged emerald leaves drift gently through the sunlit air. Behind the wand, a radiant Art Nouveau sunburst of warm amber-vermilion and molten antique gold glows against a deep velvety midnight-indigo sky. Far below, a winding gilded river crosses a verdant twilight valley toward a small distant stone castle perched on a bright sunlit hill. Crisp luminous highlights sculpt the hand, the single flowering wand, and the drifting leaves for unmistakable clarity.
promptSpec.compositionNote: Single bold vertical golden-bronze wand held dead-center against a radiant amber-ivory sunburst halo; reads unmistakably as Ace of Wands at 64x96 thumbnail size.

archetypeEssence.en: Standing on the parapet with the world in hand—turning raw potential into a deliberate long-range plan.
archetypeEssence.zh: 立于城垛之上掌托寰宇——把手中潜力沉淀为清晰的长远规划与出走抉择。

en: Cloaked figure standing on a castle battlement gazing across sea and mountains
Miniature terrestrial globe held thoughtfully in the right hand
Two sprouting wands—one bolted to the stone parapet, one gripped in the left hand
Carved rose, lily, and cross emblem on the stone wall marking balanced intent
zh: 身披斗篷立于城堡垛口、远眺山海的眺望者
右手稳稳托在掌心的微缩地球仪
两根发芽权杖——一根固定于石墙，一根握于左手
石墙上雕刻的玫瑰与百合徽记，象征理性与热情的平衡

en: Belle Epoque visionary in crimson-and-indigo cloak standing atop a warm stone battlement overlooking a moonlit-and-amber sea
Miniature gilded astrolabe globe glowing in their outstretched right palm
Exactly two tall sprouting bronze-and-wood wands—one clasped vertically in their left hand, one mounted upright in an iron bracket on the stone parapet behind them
Warm golden horizon glow separating the figure, globe, and two upright wands from deep midnight-indigo waters
zh: 身披绯红与靛蓝斗篷、立于暖色石垛远眺海天之际的美好年代远望者
右手掌心泛起暖光的鎏金微缩地球仪
清晰可数的两根发芽古铜木杖——一根握于左手，一根以铁环固定在身后石墙上
远方暖金地平线将人物、地球仪与两根竖立权杖从深邃午夜海色中利落衬出

core.en: Two of Wands is the moment between comfort and expansion: you have already secured your castle wall, and now you hold the globe, weighing which wider horizon deserves your next commitment.
core.zh: 权杖二处于安稳与远行之间的关键节点：你已经守住了脚下的城墙，此刻手托地球仪，正在权衡哪片更开阔的疆域值得你下一步投入。

message.en: Think bigger than maintenance—step back, map the wider terrain, and choose the direction you actually want to build toward.
message.zh: 别只满足于维持现状——站高一步看清全局地形，选定你真正想前往的方向。

foundation.en: Early success or steady groundwork gave you a safe base, which is why you now have the leverage to plan ambitiously.
foundation.zh: 前期的稳固积累为你搭好了安全底座，正因如此你现在才拥有从容筹划远景的筹码。

present.en: You are at a strategic overlook comparing two paths: staying inside known territory or committing to a larger venture.
present.zh: 你正站在战略观景台上面临抉择：留在熟悉领地，还是迈向更大格局的新局。

challenge.en: Staying on the balcony too long is the snag: planning feels safe, but at some point you have to leave the parapet.
challenge.zh: 症结在于在观景台上站得太久：做规划很安全，但到了某个时候，你总得离开城垛。

resource.en: Your greatest advantage is foresight—you can see how the pieces connect before spending energy on the march.
resource.zh: 你最大的优势是前瞻视野——在真正动身耗费力气前，就能把全局脉络看得明明白白。

action.en: Pick one concrete destination, set a realistic timeline and first milestone, and commit resources to leaving port.
action.zh: 明确选定一个目标方向，排好务实时间线与首个里程碑，正式把资源投入出航准备。

outcome.en: If you keep to this course, a clear long-term plan and confident personal authority tend to set the stage for genuine outward expansion.
outcome.zh: 若照此走下去，清晰的长远规划与笃定的掌控感，往往能为切实的向外拓展铺好舞台。

advice.en: Keep one hand on what is proven while your eyes measure the horizon; bold vision works best with a calm map.
advice.zh: 一手稳住已有根基，双眼丈量远方地平线；宏大愿景配上冷静地图才最走得远。

hidden.en: Look at whether you have privately chosen already. A preference for the wider option may be shaping what you research and whom you ask, while you still describe yourself as undecided.
hidden.zh: 看看你是不是心里早就选好了。对更大那条路的偏向，也许已经在影响你查什么资料、向谁打听，而你嘴上还说自己没想好。

self.en: You stand here as a planner with real leverage: secure enough to choose, looking past your current walls, and taking the long view before you commit yourself.
self.zh: 你是以手握筹码的规划者姿态出现的：底气足以让你自己做选择，目光已越过眼前的城墙，只是想把长远看清再下注。

other.en: They seem to be weighing options from a secure position. The other person is likely thinking long-term and comparing possibilities, and may not commit until they have surveyed the whole map.
other.zh: 对方似乎正站在稳妥的位置上权衡选项，大概在做长远打算、比较各种可能；在把整张地图看完之前，他们未必会表态。

external.en: The wider field is open for planning: there is room to expand, more than one viable route, and no outside deadline forcing your hand yet.
external.zh: 大环境给了你规划的余地：有向外拓展的空间，可行的路线不止一条，眼下也没有哪个外部期限逼你马上表态。

hopes_fears.en: You hope a bigger world is waiting beyond what you have built, yet fear that reaching for it means risking the safe ground that took you so long to secure.
hopes_fears.zh: 你期待在已经建好的一切之外，还有更大的世界在等你；又怕伸手去够，就得拿好不容易站稳的这块安全地带去冒险。

general.en: Strategic planning and future vision take center stage. Step above daily details, weigh your options honestly, and prepare to move beyond familiar walls.
general.zh: 战略规划与长远视野是此刻核心。跳出琐碎日常站高一步，冷静权衡选项，为走出熟悉舒适区做好准备。

love.en: In love, Two of Wands asks what shared future you are actually building—long-distance plans, moving in, or deciding whether both partners want the same horizon.
love.zh: 在感情中，权杖二邀请你们对齐共同的未来蓝图——无论是异地规划、共同生活，还是确认彼此是否望向同一片远方。

career.en: At work, this is classic roadmap and expansion energy: scaling a product, exploring international or cross-functional roles, and choosing long-term leverage over busywork.
career.zh: 在工作与事业上，这是典型的路线图与版图拓展期：扩大业务边界、评估跨领域或远方机会，用长远杠杆取代低效忙碌。

health.en: Look beyond short-term fixes and design a sustainable seasonal routine—checkups, training milestones, and rest rhythms that support where you want to be months from now.
health.zh: 在身心管理上，跳出临时抱佛脚的念头，为未来几个月的精力状态规划可持续的作息、锻炼节点与体检安排。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, Two of Wands invites you to widen your personal worldview—explore a new teacher, tradition, or contemplative horizon with steady discernment.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，权杖二鼓励你拓宽内在世界观——带着清醒与好奇去接触更开阔的智慧传统或修行视野。

core.en: Two of Wands reversed highlights fear of change, small thinking, or clinging to familiar walls even when you have clearly outgrown them.
core.zh: 权杖二逆位指向对改变的顾虑、视野收缩，或明知已经长出旧框却仍紧紧抓住熟悉城墙不放。

blocked.en: Indecision and fear of losing comfort are keeping a viable expansion permanently on paper.
blocked.zh: 犹豫不决与害怕失去安稳，让原本可行的拓展计划永远停在纸面上。

excess.en: Over-planning every contingency until analysis becomes a polite excuse not to leave port.
excess.zh: 把每个细节都过度推演，让精细规划变成了迟迟不出航的体面借口。

internalized.en: Quietly downsizing your own ambitions to avoid risk or other people's scrutiny.
internalized.zh: 为了避开风险或外界审视，在心里悄悄调低了原本属于你的野心。

release.en: Letting go of an outdated plan that no longer fits reality so you can redraw a truer map.
release.zh: 放下那份早已不合时宜的旧计划，重新画一张贴合当下真实处境的地图。

message.en: The walls that once protected you are starting to confine you. Admit that you have outgrown this arrangement, even if you are not ready to leave it yet.
message.zh: 曾经保护你的那道墙，正开始把你圈住。先承认自己已经长出了这个旧框，哪怕你还没准备好离开。

foundation.en: Behind this lies a decision that kept being postponed: a plan revised many times but never launched, or an ambition trimmed to fit what felt safe at the time.
foundation.zh: 这背后是一个一再推迟的决定：一份改了很多遍却始终没启动的计划，或是当初为了求稳而被你削小的志向。

present.en: You keep circling the same few options without choosing one. The plan exists; what is missing is the willingness to leave the familiar spot.
present.zh: 同样的几个选项，你想了一遍又一遍，却始终没有选定。计划是有的，缺的是离开熟悉位置的那份意愿。

challenge.en: Playing it too small—shrinking the plan to fit your fears, or stalling behind one more round of analysis—is undercutting the leverage you already hold.
challenge.zh: 格局放得太小——把计划缩到刚好装下顾虑，或躲在又一轮推演后面迟迟不动——正在削弱你原本握有的主动权。

resource.en: Your caution has left you something solid: a base that still holds and a detailed sense of the risks. A plan drawn smaller can be carried out sooner, and the old map is yours to redraw.
resource.zh: 谨慎也给你留下了实在的东西：根基还稳，风险也摸得很清楚。规模小一点的计划反而能更早落地，旧地图随时可以由你重画。

action.en: Name the exact fear keeping you on the wall, cap the downside with a small test, and make one real decision.
action.zh: 直白说出让你迟疑的那个具体担忧，用低成本小测试兜底，然后做出一个真正的决定。

outcome.en: Progress stalls in familiar territory until you either commit to a revised plan or accept staying put consciously.
outcome.zh: 局面会暂时停留在熟悉圈层里，直到你真正选定修正后的路线，或清醒接受暂缓出航。

advice.en: Stop waiting for risk to vanish; a modest imperfect map beats endless pacing behind the battlement.
advice.zh: 别等风险完全归零；一张朴素却能上路的地图，胜过在城垛后无休止地来回踱步。

hidden.en: Check whether “not the right time” is covering a fear of being seen to fail. An ambition you scaled down without telling anyone may still be the one you actually want.
hidden.zh: 想一想，“时机还不对”是不是在替“怕被人看见失败”打掩护。那个你没告诉任何人就悄悄调低的目标，也许仍是你真正想要的。

self.en: You present yourself as sensible and settled, while part of you knows you are playing a smaller game than you could. Reluctance to risk comfort is doing most of the steering.
self.zh: 你把自己表现得稳妥又安分，心里却明白，你本可以做得比现在更大。不愿拿安稳去冒险的心态，才是眼下真正握着方向盘的。

other.en: The other party may be reluctant to move beyond what they know. They appear to stall, ask for more detail, or keep plans vague; read that as caution about change before you read it as refusal.
other.zh: 对方可能不太愿意走出自己熟悉的范围，表现为拖着不定、反复要更多细节，或把计划说得很含糊；先把这看作对变化的谨慎，别急着当成拒绝。

external.en: Circumstances are not inviting bold moves right now: options are narrower than they looked, the people around you favor the familiar, and an older plan no longer matches conditions.
external.zh: 眼下的环境并不鼓励大动作：选择比看上去少，周围的人都偏向老路子，早先定下的计划也已经对不上现在的形势。

hopes_fears.en: The hope is that staying put will keep everything you have safe; the fear is that you will look back and see the horizon was open and you never left the wall.
hopes_fears.zh: 你希望按兵不动能保住手里的一切；怕的是日后回头才发现，当时远方明明敞开着，自己却始终没走下那道城墙。

general.en: Fear of change or small thinking may be boxing you in. Re-examine your assumptions, trim over-complicated plans, and take one honest step toward wider ground.
general.zh: 权杖二逆位提醒你留意是否因害怕变动或格局受限而画地为牢。重新核对前提假设，精简过度复杂的方案，迈出诚实的一步。

love.en: In relationships, reversed Two of Wands signals hesitation about next steps or mismatched long-term visions. Talk openly about what feels uncertain instead of stalling.
love.zh: 在感情中，权杖二逆位反映对下一阶段犹豫不决或长远期待错位。把心里真正没底的地方摊开聊清，比原地拖延更负责。

career.en: At work, beware clinging to a safe but stagnant role, or expanding without a real plan. Clarify your non-negotiables and test one concrete next move.
career.zh: 在职场上，警惕困在安稳却停滞的舒适区里，也要避免毫无章法的盲目扩张。先理清底线诉求，再测试一个具体动作。

health.en: Perfectionist planning can keep you from actually starting; drop the elaborate regimen and commit to one simple daily habit you will keep.
health.zh: 在身心调节上，过于繁琐的完美计划反而让人迟迟无法开始；放下花哨方案，先落实一个每天都能坚持的简单习惯。

spirituality.en: Notice where familiar certainty is crowding out growth; curiosity returns the moment you admit you don't have the whole map yet.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，觉察对确定感的依赖是否挤占了成长空间；当你坦然承认自己尚未看全地图，好奇与敞开就会重新回来。

promptSpec.suitAccent: warm sunlit amber-vermilion, copper-bronze, sprouting emerald leaves, molten antique gold, luminous warm ivory
promptSpec.scene: A poised Belle Epoque visionary in a rich vermilion-crimson cloak and embroidered indigo tunic standing atop a carved pale-stone castle battlement overlooking a vast twilight sea and distant mountains. Seen in graceful three-quarter view, they gaze thoughtfully out toward the warm golden horizon, cradling ONE gleaming miniature gilded terrestrial globe in their raised right hand. Their left hand grips EXACTLY ONE tall upright sprouting bronze-and-wood wand resting on the parapet, while a SECOND identical sprouting bronze-and-wood wand stands bolted upright in an ornate iron ring against the stone battlement behind them—EXACTLY TWO tall wands total, clearly separated on either side of the figure. Warm amber-ivory sunset light illuminates the visionary's profile, the glowing globe, and both emerald-leaved wands against deep midnight-indigo waters.

requiredObjects.object: gilded miniature terrestrial globe in hand

promptSpec.compositionNote: Clear vertical framing of the figure flanked by TWO distinct upright wands and a bright glowing golden globe held against open twilight sea; reads effortlessly at 64x96 thumbnail.

archetypeEssence.en: The first ships are already at sea—foresight, expansion, and watching early enterprise return across open water.
archetypeEssence.zh: 首批船队已扬帆出海——凭借远见与布局，站在高处静候早期投入跨越山海回流。

en: Cloaked figure standing on a high cliff looking out over golden sea waters
Three tall sprouting wands planted firmly into the rocky headland around the figure
Sailing ships crossing the bright harbor toward distant mountains
Steady forward-looking stance signaling enterprise already set in motion
zh: 立于高崖之上极目远眺金色海面的旅人
稳稳插在崖顶岩石间的三根发芽权杖
驶向远方群山与彼岸的扬帆商船
沉稳前瞻的背影，象征事业已正式启航

en: Belle Epoque navigator in amber-vermilion and deep indigo cloak standing on a high luminous cliff overlooking a shimmering golden-indigo bay
Exactly three tall sprouting bronze-and-wood wands planted upright in the rocky headland—one held lightly in the right hand and two planted clearly to the left and right
Three graceful distant sailing ships gliding across warm gilded water toward misty twilight mountains
Expansive sunlit-amber sky opening wide above deep midnight-indigo coastal cliffs
zh: 身披琥珀绯红与深靛斗篷、立于高崖远望金蓝海湾的美好年代领航者
清晰可数的三根发芽古铜木杖——右手轻扶一根，左右崖石各稳立一根
驶过鎏金波光、奔向暮色远山的优雅帆船
高阔暖金天光在深邃午夜海崖之上豁然铺开

core.en: Three of Wands confirms that your early moves have left the harbor. Expansion, trade, and longer-range momentum are now underway—keep your eyes on the horizon and prepare to receive what returns.
core.zh: 权杖三确认你的前期布局已经顺利离港。拓展、合作与更长远的势头正在海上推进——保持前瞻视野，做好承接回报的准备。

message.en: Your groundwork is already working at a distance; widen your lens and prepare for the next stage of scale.
message.zh: 你此前播下的布局已经在远方发力；把格局再放大一圈，准备承接下一阶段的拓展。

foundation.en: A decisive choice to step beyond your comfort zone set these ventures in motion.
foundation.zh: 此前果断走出舒适区的那一次落子，让如今的远航与拓展真正启动起来。

present.en: Momentum is actively building beyond your immediate view; stay patient, track incoming signals, and ready your capacity.
present.zh: 势头正在你眼前的海岸线之外持续累积；保持耐心、留意远方信号，并提前备好承接能力。

challenge.en: Impatience while the ships are still mid-voyage is the risk here, along with neglecting the logistics you need ready when they dock.
challenge.zh: 风险在于船队尚在途中就心浮气躁，以及忽略了靠岸时必须备好的承接安排。

resource.en: Your strongest asset is strategic foresight combined with alliances or distribution channels that extend your reach.
resource.zh: 你最强的优势是前瞻格局，以及能把你的影响力送到更远处的伙伴与渠道。

action.en: Expand your reach deliberately—follow up with distant partners, publish to a wider audience, or prepare systems for incoming demand.
action.zh: 有意识地把触角伸远一步——跟进跨界或远方伙伴、面向更广受众发布，或提前备好承接流量的体系。

outcome.en: Efforts you launched earlier are likely to return as tangible growth, wider recognition, or rewarding results, provided you stay ready to receive them.
outcome.zh: 只要你做好承接的准备，前期的投入很可能带来看得见的增长、更广泛的认可或可观的回报。

advice.en: Trust the work already in motion and use this vantage point to plan the second voyage, not micromanage the first.
advice.zh: 信任已经上路的布局，借此刻的高处视野去筹划第二程，而不必反复拉扯第一程。

hidden.en: Something you set in motion may be progressing where you cannot see it. Before assuming nothing is happening, look for early signals you have overlooked: a reply, a referral, a quiet uptick.
hidden.zh: 你启动的事情，可能正在你看不见的地方推进。先别认定毫无动静，查查有没有被你漏掉的早期信号：一封回信，一次转介绍，或一点悄悄的起色。

self.en: You show up as someone who has already committed and now thinks ahead: watching the horizon, confident in what you sent out, and planning for scale instead of survival.
self.zh: 你是以已经下注、正在向前看的姿态出现的：眼睛望着远方，对自己放出去的东西有信心，盘算的是怎么做大，而不是怎么撑下去。

other.en: Their attention appears to be directed outward and ahead. The other person may have plans already in motion elsewhere, and is likely to judge this matter by where it could lead over time.
other.zh: 从表现来看，对方正把目光投向外面和更远处，可能在别处已经有计划在推进；他们很可能会用“长远能走到哪一步”来衡量这件事。

external.en: Conditions beyond your immediate circle are favorable: distant contacts, wider markets, or partners elsewhere are responsive, and things already in transit are moving at their own pace.
external.zh: 你身边这个小圈子之外的条件是有利的：远方的联系人、更大的市场或外地的伙伴都有回应，已经在路上的事情正按它自己的节奏前行。

hopes_fears.en: You hope the ships you sent out return full and prove your foresight right, yet fear the long wait will end with an empty harbor and nothing to show for the risk.
hopes_fears.zh: 你盼着派出去的船满载而归，证明自己当初看得准；又怕等了这么久，港口依然空空，冒的险什么也没换来。

general.en: Expansion and foresight are paying off as early initiatives gain traction. Keep your gaze broad and get ready to welcome growing opportunities.
general.zh: 前期行动正逐步转化为拓展与势头，远见开始显现回报。保持开阔视野，为陆续靠岸的新机会做好准备。

love.en: In love, Three of Wands points to looking ahead together—travel, shared goals, or giving a promising connection room to grow beyond initial sparks.
love.zh: 在感情中，权杖三代表共同望向更远的未来——一起旅行、筹划共同目标，或给一段有潜力的关系足够空间去延展。

career.en: At work, this is strong growth and international/cross-team reach: proposals are out, partnerships are forming, and scaling up is the natural next step.
career.zh: 在工作与事业上，这是稳步扩张与跨界合作的良机：提案已发出、合作在成形，顺势放大规模正是自然下一步。

health.en: Consistent habits are beginning to show real progress—stay steady with your routine and set a slightly more ambitious, realistic next milestone.
health.zh: 在身心状态上，此前坚持的调理与锻炼正开始显现成效——稳住节奏，可以顺势定一个更进一步的务实小目标。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, Three of Wands rewards patient vision: your practice is widening your horizon and connecting you to a larger sense of purpose.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，权杖三回馈你沉稳的远见：持续修习正拓宽你的心量，让你与更宏阔的人生意义产生共振。

core.en: Three of Wands reversed signals delays in transit, limited growth, or frustration when early ventures take longer—or return smaller—than you hoped.
core.zh: 权杖三逆位提示远方消息延迟、拓展受限，或早期投入的回报比预期更慢、更小所带来的焦躁。

blocked.en: Logistical snags, slow replies, or missing groundwork are delaying expected returns.
blocked.zh: 流程卡点、对方回复缓慢或前期细节未补齐，正在拖慢预期回报的到来。

excess.en: Overextending into too many distant markets or promises before home operations are solid.
excess.zh: 后方根基尚未扎稳就急于铺开过多远方战线，导致精力与资源被稀释。

internalized.en: Quietly doubting your own vision because results haven't docked on your preferred schedule.
internalized.zh: 因为成果还没按你期望的时间表靠岸，开始在心里悄悄怀疑自己当初的判断。

release.en: Recalling an unprofitable venture early so you can redirect your fleet to better waters.
release.zh: 果断召回回报不佳的远航项目，把船队与资源重新调往更有前景的海域。

message.en: A slower return is information, not failure. Use the delay to find the weak link in your plan before you send anything else out.
message.zh: 回报来得慢，是一条信息，不是失败。趁这段延迟找出计划里薄弱的那一环，再决定要不要继续往外铺。

foundation.en: An earlier push outward ran ahead of its preparation: a launch with loose logistics, promises made on optimistic timelines, or expansion started before the base was steady.
foundation.zh: 早先那次向外推进，跑在了准备工作的前面：流程没理顺就上线，按乐观的时间表许了诺，或者后方还没站稳就开始扩张。

present.en: You are still waiting on something that should have arrived by now. Results are trickling in below expectation, and the gap between the plan and reality is hard to ignore.
present.zh: 你还在等一个本该已经到了的结果。回报零零星星，比预期少，计划和现实之间的落差已经很难视而不见。

challenge.en: Unrealistic timelines or unverified assumptions about distant partners are creating avoidable disappointment.
challenge.zh: 过于乐观的时间预期，或对外部合作方未经核实的假设，正在带来本可避免的落空感。

resource.en: The delay has shown you exactly where the route breaks down, and that knowledge is paid for. Your home base is still standing, and a smaller, well-supplied effort is within reach.
resource.zh: 这次延误让你看清了路线究竟断在哪里，这是花了代价换来的经验。你的大本营还在，做一个规模小些、补给充足的尝试完全够得着。

action.en: Audit the supply line: check where the delay actually sits, tighten your scope, and fix one local bottleneck before expanding again.
action.zh: 逐一排查链路堵点：看清延误究竟卡在何处，先收紧范围、修好本地环节，再谈继续扩张。

outcome.en: Growth is likely to come more slowly or on a smaller scale than first projected, and that gap offers valuable feedback for refining the route.
outcome.zh: 增长很可能比最初预想的更慢或规模更小，而这段落差恰好提供了修正航线的宝贵反馈。

advice.en: Treat a delayed ship as a logistics check, not a verdict on your worth; adjust the sails and keep your base strong.
advice.zh: 把船期延误当作一次航线核查，而非对你价值的否定；调整风帆，先守稳大本营。

hidden.en: Consider whether the real obstacle is closer than the horizon: an unanswered message, a step you skipped, or a private doubt about your own plan that has slowed your follow-through.
hidden.zh: 想想真正的障碍是不是比远方近得多：一条没回的消息，一个被你跳过的步骤，或是你对自己计划的暗暗怀疑，让跟进慢了下来。

self.en: You are standing at the lookout with thinning patience: checking for results too often, doubting your earlier judgment, and tempted either to pull back entirely or to overreach to compensate.
self.zh: 你站在瞭望的位置上，耐心越来越薄：隔一会儿就去看有没有结果，怀疑当初的判断，既想干脆全部收回，又想加码硬补。

other.en: The other side may be slower or less available than you counted on. They appear to reply late or deliver less than promised, likely because of their own constraints and not ill will.
other.zh: 对方可能比你预想的更慢、更难联系上，表现为回复迟、给到的比答应的少；这多半是他们自身条件受限，未必是有意怠慢。

external.en: Factors far from your desk are slowing things: shipping, approvals, other people's schedules, or a market cooler than forecast. You can adjust to them, but you cannot hurry them.
external.zh: 拖慢进度的是离你很远的因素：物流、审批、别人的日程，或是比预测更冷的市场。你可以跟着调整，却没法催它们加快。

hopes_fears.en: You hope the wait is only a delay and your plan remains sound, yet fear that you misjudged the whole venture and reached further than you could supply.
hopes_fears.zh: 你希望这只是多等一阵，计划本身依然站得住；又怕自己从头就看走了眼，把线拉得比供得上的更远。

general.en: Delays or limited growth ask you to review the practical details behind your big vision. Shore up your base before pushing further out.
general.zh: 权杖三逆位提示推进延迟或拓展受限，需要回过头核查宏大愿景背后的落地细节。先稳固后方，再继续向外延伸。

love.en: In relationships, reversed Three of Wands can reflect distance, postponed plans, or feeling out of sync on future pacing. Reconnect in the present before forcing big milestones.
love.zh: 在感情中，权杖三逆位常对应距离感、计划推迟或对未来节奏步调不一。先在当下重新对齐温度，不必急着硬推大节点。

career.en: At work, expect slower approvals, supply/partner bottlenecks, or smaller initial traction. Diagnose what isn't converting instead of doubling down blindly.
career.zh: 在职场上，可能遇到审批偏慢、合作方卡壳或初期增长不及预期。先诊断转化堵点，切忌在没查清原因前盲目加码。

health.en: Results may feel slower than hoped; resist abandoning solid habits too early, and check whether sleep or stress is quietly slowing recovery.
health.zh: 在身心调理上，成效可能来得比预期慢；别因一时心急放弃好习惯，先排查睡眠或隐性压力是否在拖慢恢复。

spirituality.en: Patience is the practice here—let go of demanding visible signs on a deadline and stay grounded in daily presence.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，此刻的功课正是耐心——放下按截止日期索要外在印证的执念，安稳回到每一天的踏实当下。

promptSpec.suitAccent: warm sunlit amber-vermilion, copper-bronze, sprouting emerald leaves, molten antique gold, luminous warm ivory
promptSpec.scene: A poised Belle Epoque navigator seen from three-quarter back view standing on a high luminous coastal cliff overlooking a wide, shimmering golden-and-indigo bay. Dressed in a flowing amber-vermilion and deep indigo cloak with gold Art Nouveau trim, they gaze out toward distant misty mountains where three graceful antique sailing ships glide across sunlit waters. Planted firmly and upright in the rocky cliff around the figure are EXACTLY THREE tall sprouting bronze-and-wood wands with tiny emerald leaves—one held steadily by the navigator's right hand, a second planted clearly to their left, and a third planted clearly to their right, all three cleanly separated against the bright amber-ivory sky and gleaming sea.

requiredObjects.object: tall upright sprouting bronze-and-wood wands planted on cliff

promptSpec.compositionNote: Strong triadic vertical rhythm of THREE clearly separated wands framing the cliffside figure against a luminous golden-amber bay; unmistakable silhouette at 64x96 thumbnail.

archetypeEssence.en: A joyful threshold earned through real effort—homecoming, celebration, and stable shelter worth savoring.
archetypeEssence.zh: 用扎实努力换来的欢庆之门——归属、庆典与值得细细品味的安稳港湾。

en: Four upright wands forming a festive floral canopy garlanded with blossoms and fruit
Two joyful figures raising bouquets in welcome beneath the garlanded arch
Warm stone villa or castle with a welcoming bridge in the background
Gathered guests celebrating a milestone of harmony and homecoming
zh: 四根竖立权杖搭起、缀满花果彩带的欢庆花门
在花门下高举花束欢呼相迎的两位喜悦身影
后方温暖安稳的石造庄园与石桥
共庆阶段圆满与归家的亲友人群

en: Four tall sprouting bronze-and-wood wands standing upright in two symmetrical pairs supporting a lush Art Nouveau garland of ivory roses, amber blossoms, and emerald vines
Two radiant Belle Epoque celebrants in luminous ivory and warm vermilion-gold silk raising floral bouquets beneath the canopy
Warm lantern-lit stone villa and arched bridge glowing in the twilight garden behind them
Festive warm amber-gold lantern light contrasting joyfully against starry midnight-indigo sky
zh: 左右对称成对竖立、托起玫瑰与翠藤华盖的四根发芽古铜木杖
在花门下身穿月白与暖金丝裙、高举花束欢庆的两位美好年代庆贺者
后方亮着暖灯的石造庄园与花园拱桥
星夜靛蓝天幕下熠熠生辉的暖琥珀灯火与节庆光晕

core.en: Four of Wands marks a genuine milestone of stability, homecoming, and shared celebration. Pause long enough to enjoy the shelter you have built before rushing toward the next climb.
core.zh: 权杖四标志着真实可感的稳固、归属与共庆时刻。在急着奔赴下一座山之前，先停下来好好享受你亲手搭起的安稳屋檐。

message.en: Mark this milestone out loud—you have reached solid ground, and celebrating it anchors the stability you worked for.
message.zh: 大大方方庆祝这个里程碑——你已经站上坚实地面，认真庆贺会让这份安稳真正落袋。

foundation.en: A supportive home base, warm community, or completed foundational milestone gave you the stability you stand on now.
foundation.zh: 安稳的后方、温暖的圈子或此前顺利落地的阶段成果，为你托住了今天的底气。

present.en: Harmony and welcome surround you right now—a great window for gatherings, moving in, hosting, or enjoying earned peace.
present.zh: 此刻正处于融洽与被接纳的窗口期——适合相聚、乔迁、举办庆典，或安心享受应得的松弛。

challenge.en: Ask whether you are skipping celebration out of habit—or mistaking a happy milestone for the final finish line.
challenge.zh: 问问自己：是否出于惯性跳过了庆祝，或者把一次值得高兴的阶段成果误当成了最后的终点线。

resource.en: Your strongest asset is a dependable sanctuary—people, routines, or a physical space that genuinely restores you.
resource.zh: 你最宝贵的资源是一个可靠的栖息地——那些真正能让你卸下防备、恢复元气的人与空间。

action.en: Gather the people who helped you get here, host a simple toast, or invest care into making your home or team space feel welcoming.
action.zh: 把一路支持你的人聚在一起简单举杯，或用心打理你的居住与协作空间，让归属感落到实处。

outcome.en: This course leans toward a warm homecoming, joyful ceremony, or stable foundational win, with a relief and belonging that are likely to last.
outcome.zh: 照此发展，多半会迎来一次温暖的归家、一场欢庆仪式或一项稳固的阶段成果，那份安心与归属感也很可能持久。

advice.en: Let yourself cross the threshold with gratitude; joy shared in a steady structure fuels everything that comes next.
advice.zh: 带着感激跨过这道花门；在安稳结构里共享的喜悦，会为下一程注入源源不断的能量。

hidden.en: Notice the support you may be taking for granted. A steady home base or loyal circle could be holding more of this up than you have acknowledged, and it deserves a look and a thank-you.
hidden.zh: 留意那些你可能习以为常的支持。安稳的后方或一直挺你的那群人，替你撑住的也许比你意识到的更多，值得你认真看一眼、道一声谢。

self.en: You arrive as someone who has built something solid and is ready to share it: open, hospitable, and more at ease than you have been in a long while.
self.zh: 你是带着已经建成的成果来的，也愿意与人分享：敞开、好客，比过去很长一段时间都更放松自在。

other.en: The other person appears welcoming and glad to include you. They are likely looking for stability and shared occasions, and their behaviour suggests they want you in the circle.
other.zh: 对方看起来很欢迎你，也乐意把你算在内；他们似乎看重安稳和一起度过的时刻，从举动来看，是希望你留在这个圈子里的。

external.en: The setting is supportive: family, team, or community is in a generous mood, and an occasion such as a gathering, a move, or a shared milestone gives everyone a reason to come together.
external.zh: 周围环境是托着你的：家人、团队或社群氛围融洽，而一次聚会、搬迁或共同的里程碑，正好给了大家聚到一起的理由。

hopes_fears.en: You long to arrive somewhere you fully belong and can stop proving yourself, and you worry that settling down will make you comfortable enough to stop growing.
hopes_fears.zh: 你盼着终于能有一个真正属于自己的地方，不必再向谁证明什么；又怕一旦安顿下来，日子舒服得让你不再往前走。

general.en: Celebration, homecoming, and steady structure align here. Honor what you have built and enjoy the warmth of belonging with people who truly welcome you.
general.zh: 欢庆、归属与稳固结构在此汇聚。好好肯定已经建成的成果，与真正欢迎你的人共享这份踏实暖意。

love.en: In love, Four of Wands is classic joyful commitment—moving in together, engagements, anniversaries, or simply feeling deeply at home with each other.
love.zh: 在感情中，权杖四代表温暖笃定的承诺与归属——同居、订婚、纪念日，或在彼此身边感受到彻底安心的“回家感”。

career.en: At work, celebrate a successful launch, graduation, or team milestone. Strong culture and clear structure make this a rewarding moment to consolidate gains.
career.zh: 在工作与学业上，适合庆祝项目上线、毕业或团队阶段胜利。良好的氛围与稳固框架正是巩固成果的好时机。

health.en: Wellbeing thrives on a calm, supportive environment—tidy your space, share a nourishing meal, and let joyful relaxation lower baseline stress.
health.zh: 在身心状态上，安稳舒心的环境最养人——整理居住空间、与亲友共享一顿好饭，让发自内心的放松卸下紧绷。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, Four of Wands honors ritual and gratitude: sacredness lives in welcoming thresholds, shared tables, and grounded joy.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，权杖四礼赞仪式感与感恩：神圣不必远求，它就藏在温暖的门槛、共享的餐桌与踏实的喜悦里。

core.en: Four of Wands reversed points to either a quiet, private celebration kept out of the spotlight, or temporary instability around home, belonging, or an unfinished foundation.
core.zh: 权杖四逆位指向两种常见状态：要么是一场低调私密的内部庆祝，要么是居家、归属或根基尚未完全落稳带来的轻微晃动。

blocked.en: Delays in a move, event, or milestone are postponing the sense of settled relief.
blocked.zh: 搬迁、聚会或关键节点的推迟，让原本期待的尘埃落定暂时延后。

excess.en: Pouring energy into staging a picture-perfect celebration while ignoring real friction underneath.
excess.zh: 把心力都花在摆出光鲜体面的庆祝场面上，却忽略了底下真实的摩擦。

internalized.en: A meaningful private victory you prefer to savor quietly rather than announce to a crowd.
internalized.zh: 一份对你很重要的私密胜利，你更愿意安静独享而非大张旗鼓宣布。

release.en: Outgrowing an old definition of home or community so you can build one that genuinely fits.
release.zh: 告别不再合身的旧归属感，为自己腾出空间去搭建真正契合的新港湾。

message.en: Home does not have to look finished to be real. Tend the one thing that feels unsettled, and let yourself mark your progress privately without waiting for a perfect occasion.
message.zh: 家不必看起来样样齐全才算数。先照看那件让你不踏实的事，也允许自己私下为进展庆祝一下，不用等一个完美的场合。

foundation.en: This grew out of a period of unsettled footing: a move or milestone that was postponed, a household in flux, or a group where you never felt entirely included.
foundation.zh: 这一切源自一段脚下不稳的时期：被推迟的搬迁或重要节点，变动中的家庭，或是一个你始终没能完全融入的群体。

present.en: Things are between places. The celebration is on hold or scaled down, the base is still being assembled, and the feeling of being settled has not arrived yet.
present.zh: 事情正处在两头不靠的阶段：庆祝被搁置或缩小了规模，根基还在搭，尘埃落定的踏实感也还没到来。

challenge.en: Unsettled home dynamics, skipped foundations, or feeling out of place in a group are quietly draining peace.
challenge.zh: 尚未安顿的居家事务、略过基础的赶工，或在群体中的格格不入，正在悄悄消耗安宁。

resource.en: You already know what makes a place feel like home to you and what only looks like it. A small circle that is honest with you, and a win you can enjoy without an audience, are both available.
resource.zh: 你已经分得清，什么让一个地方真正像家，什么只是看上去像。一个对你说真话的小圈子，和一份不需要观众也能享受的成果，你手里都有。

action.en: Fix one practical instability at home or in your base routine first, and keep any celebration small, warm, and honest.
action.zh: 先修补居家或基础日程里最晃动的一环，把庆祝缩回小而真诚、不必撑场面的尺度。

outcome.en: Stability returns once loose ends are tied down, even if the milestone feels quieter and more personal than expected.
outcome.zh: 只要把松动的细节一一扎牢，安稳感就会回来，只是这份收官可能比预想更安静私密。

advice.en: Build real comfort over appearances; a modest, honest sanctuary beats a grand canopy over shaky posts.
advice.zh: 重实质安稳轻表面排场；朴素真诚的港湾，远胜过立在松动柱子上的华丽花门。

hidden.en: Look beneath a pleasant surface for friction no one is naming. It is also worth checking whether you have quietly outgrown a place or group you still call home out of habit.
hidden.zh: 看看和气的表面底下，有没有谁都不提的摩擦。也值得想一想，那个你出于习惯仍叫作家的地方或圈子，是不是已经悄悄不合身了。

self.en: You show up a little apart from the festivities: keeping your good news close, unsure whether you fit, or busy holding things together while others assume all is well.
self.zh: 你站在热闹的边上：把好消息留在自己心里，不确定是否融得进去，或是在别人以为一切都好的时候，独自忙着把局面撑住。

other.en: Their own base may be unsettled right now. The other person appears distracted by home or team matters, or keeps the relationship low-key, and is likely not ready for a public step.
other.zh: 对方眼下可能自己的后方就不太安稳，看上去被家里或团队的事分了心，或是把这段关系处理得很低调；公开迈出一步，他们恐怕还没准备好。

external.en: Practical conditions are in flux: housing, schedules, or group arrangements keep shifting, and the people around you are too busy with their own transitions to gather properly.
external.zh: 现实条件还在变动：住处、日程或集体的安排一改再改，身边的人也各自忙着过渡，很难好好聚到一起。

hopes_fears.en: You hope for a place to belong that needs no performance from you, yet fear that if you stop keeping up appearances, the welcome will turn out to be conditional.
hopes_fears.zh: 你渴望一个不需要表演也能被接纳的归处；又怕一旦不再维持体面，才发现那份欢迎原来是有条件的。

general.en: Instability or a private celebration asks you to tend to your actual foundation. You don't need an audience to honor real progress, nor should you rush past loose ends.
general.zh: 权杖四逆位提示根基尚有晃动或更适合私下庆祝。不必为了体面硬撑场面，先把松动的日常基础稳住更重要。

love.en: In love, reversed Four of Wands can mean navigating household friction, family expectations, or keeping a budding milestone private until both of you feel settled.
love.zh: 在感情中，权杖四逆位可能涉及居家磨合、双方家庭期待，或更想把这段进展低调保护起来，等彼此更笃定再公开。

career.en: At work, team morale or workplace stability may feel transitional, or a win goes under-recognized. Anchor your own standards and shore up shaky processes.
career.zh: 在职场上，团队氛围或办公环境可能正值过渡期，或成果未获高调表彰。先稳住自身节奏与底层流程。

health.en: Disrupted routines or a chaotic living space may be quietly fraying your nerves; restore simple order and quiet rest at home.
health.zh: 在身心状态上，被打乱的作息或杂乱的居家环境可能在暗中消耗心神；先在家中恢复简单秩序与安静休养。

spirituality.en: True sanctuary starts inside—when outer settings feel unsettled, return to a small daily ritual that centers you anywhere.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，真正的庇护所生于内心——当外界环境尚在变动时，回到一个随时随地都能安顿自己的微小日常仪式。

archetypeEssence.zh: 跃跃欲试的较量与观念碰撞——引导得当能磨出真本事，放任失控则只剩喧闹内耗。

Uneven grassy hillside beneath an open bright sky

在暖金天幕前以利落斜角交锋、清晰可数的五根发芽古铜木杖
专注亢奋的神情与灵动架势，呈现的是较量而非恶意
暖朱砂与琥珀轮廓光在深邃午夜阴影中勾勒出分明动势

core.en: Five of Wands brings competition, noisy debate, and overlapping agendas. Everyone wants to be heard at once—set clear rules of engagement so the friction sharpens the work instead of exhausting the room.
core.zh: 权杖五带来竞争、喧闹的争辩与彼此交叉的诉求。每个人都急着发声——立好规则与焦点，让碰撞磨出火花而非耗干全场的力气。

message.en: Step into the arena with clarity rather than shouting louder; healthy competition reveals what actually holds up.
message.zh: 带着清晰立场走进赛场，而不是靠提高嗓门取胜；良性竞争最能试出什么方案真正站得住。

foundation.en: Competing priorities, crowded stakeholders, or an untested rivalry created the current friction.
foundation.zh: 多重诉求撞车、意见方过多或一场尚未分晓的竞争，造就了眼下的嘈杂局面。

present.en: Energy is high but uncoordinated—people are talking past each other rather than pulling in one direction.
present.zh: 眼下干劲很足但步调零散——大家各说各话，还没把力气拧到同一方向。

challenge.en: Ego clashes, petty turf wars, and cross-talk are burning time without moving the actual goal forward.
challenge.zh: 面子之争、地盘意识与各执一词的拉锯，正在空耗时间却推不动真正目标。

resource.en: Your edge is agility and creative grit; pressure-testing your idea against tough peers makes it stronger.
resource.zh: 你的优势在于临场应变与抗压韧劲；在强劲对手的碰撞下反复打磨，反而能让方案更硬核。

action.en: Call a brief time-out, name the shared objective, and turn the free-for-all into a structured debate or clear contest.
action.zh: 先叫一次简短暂停，把共同目标写到明面上，把混战变成有规则的讨论或清晰竞逐。

outcome.en: If the testing stays candid and active, the strongest approach is likely to emerge while weak assumptions get knocked out.
outcome.zh: 只要交锋保持真实与坦诚，最站得住的方案很可能脱颖而出，经不起推敲的假设则被淘汰。

advice.en: Treat friction as sparring, not a personal ambush—keep your temper cool and your aim sharp.
advice.zh: 把摩擦当作切磋而非针对个人的伏击——稳住火气，把准星对准问题本身。

hidden.en: Beneath the arguing, check what each side is really competing for. The stated topic may be a stand-in for recognition, territory, or a wish to be taken seriously.
hidden.zh: 看看争吵底下，各方真正在争的是什么。摆在台面上的议题，可能只是认可、地盘或“想被认真对待”的替身。

self.en: You are in the scrum with your own stick raised: energized by the contest, keen to prove your point, and possibly adding to the noise more than you realize.
self.zh: 你也举着木杖站在混战当中：越比越来劲，一心想证明自己有理，给这片嘈杂添的声量可能比你以为的多。

other.en: The other party appears competitive and quick to push back. They are likely testing your position more than attacking you, and may enjoy the sparring more than you do.
other.zh: 对方显得好胜，动不动就顶回来；他们更像是在试探你的立场，而不是冲着你这个人，也可能比你更享受这种过招。

external.en: You are operating in a crowded field: several people want the same thing, opinions collide in the open, and no one has yet set rules that everyone accepts.
external.zh: 你身处一个拥挤的场子：好几个人盯着同一样东西，意见在明面上撞来撞去，至今还没有一套大家都认的规则。

hopes_fears.en: You hope the contest will show that you can hold your own against strong rivals, yet fear being drowned out, or worn down by a fight that settles nothing.
hopes_fears.zh: 你希望这场较量能证明，自己在强手面前也站得住；又怕声音被盖过去，或是在一场什么也定不下来的争执里被耗光。

general.en: Competition and lively conflict are in the air. Channel the heat into constructive problem-solving by clarifying rules and listening past the noise.
general.zh: 竞争与活跃的意见冲突正在升温。先立清规则、听懂喧闹背后的真实诉求，把火气转化为有建设性的破局动力。

love.en: In love, Five of Wands shows spirited bickering, competing schedules, or two strong personalities vying for the steering wheel. Fight fair and remember you are on the same team.
love.zh: 在感情中，权杖五常对应拌嘴较劲、日程撞车或两个强势个性争夺主导权。就事论事地公平争论，别忘了你们原本是同一阵营。

career.en: At work, expect competitive bids, brainstorming chaos, or departmental turf friction. Stand your ground with concrete evidence and facilitate clear decision criteria.
career.zh: 在职场上，可能遇到竞标角逐、头脑风暴失序或跨部门拉扯。用扎实依据守住立场，并推动明确拍板标准。

health.en: Restless adrenaline and tension need a clean physical outlet—competitive sport, brisk training, or structured breathwork beats simmering irritation.
health.zh: 在身心状态上，躁动的肾上腺素与紧绷感需要畅快的释放出口——痛快运动或规律呼吸练习，远胜闷在心里生闷气。

spirituality.en: Notice where inner voices are arguing for control; you don't have to win every mental debate to find calm direction.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，留意内在是否同时有好几个声音在互相拉扯；不必赢下脑中的每一场辩论，才能找回清明的方向。

core.en: Five of Wands reversed marks either the welcome easing of conflict into compromise, or unhelpful conflict avoidance that drives real disagreement underground.
core.zh: 权杖五逆位指向冲突的转向——要么是风波平息、走向协商和解，要么是刻意回避矛盾，把真实分歧压进了水下。

blocked.en: Swallowing valid disagreement to keep surface peace, which only breeds passive resentment.
blocked.zh: 为了维持表面和气而吞下合理异议，反而让不满在暗中发酵。

excess.en: Dragging out a petty grudge or fighting dirty after the real contest has already ended.
excess.zh: 在真正的较量早已结束后，仍揪着小恩怨不放，或使出不光彩的手段继续缠斗。

internalized.en: Turning conflict inward as self-doubt or restless inner tug-of-war instead of speaking up.
internalized.zh: 不愿对外起冲突，结果把拉扯全都转成内耗与自我怀疑。

release.en: Stepping out of pointless drama and finding practical common ground.
release.zh: 主动退出毫无意义的口水战，找到务实可行的共识与台阶。

message.en: Tell apart the fights that are over from the ones you are only avoiding. Let the first kind go completely, and give the second kind one honest conversation.
message.zh: 分清哪些争执已经结束，哪些只是被你躲开了。前一种彻底放下；后一种，给它一次坦诚的对话。

foundation.en: An earlier clash was never properly finished. People either tired of it and backed off, or agreed politely in public while their real objections stayed unspoken.
foundation.zh: 早先的一场冲突其实没有真正了结：大家要么吵累了各自退开，要么当面客气地点了头，真正的反对意见却没说出口。

present.en: The volume has dropped. Either a workable truce is forming, or everyone has gone quiet to keep the peace, and it is worth finding out which of the two you are in.
present.zh: 音量已经降下来了。要么是一份行得通的休战正在成形，要么是大家为了维持和气都闭了嘴；你值得弄清楚自己处在哪一种里。

challenge.en: Unspoken tension or dodging a necessary candid conversation is quietly slowing everything down.
challenge.zh: 未说破的暗流，或刻意绕开那场必须进行的坦诚对话，正在悄悄拖慢全局。

resource.en: You have learned which arguments deserve your energy, and that lesson was not free. Your readiness to compromise is real, and it gives you room to propose terms others can accept.
resource.zh: 你已经知道哪些争论值得花力气，这份认识不是白来的。你愿意让步的诚意是真的，这让你有余地提出别人也能接受的条件。

action.en: Walk away from noisy ego battles that don't matter, and address the one real disagreement calmly one-on-one.
action.zh: 退出不值得耗神的意气之争，把唯一真正重要的分歧拉到一对一的平静对话里解决。

outcome.en: The dust settles into clearer cooperation once competing parties drop performative posturing.
outcome.zh: 当各方放下虚张声势的较劲，尘埃落定后会迎来更清爽的协作空间。

advice.en: Choose peace over drama, not silence over truth—resolve what needs resolving and decline the rest.
advice.zh: 选择和平而非戏码，但也别用沉默掩盖真问题——该谈清的谈清，其余杂音一律不接。

hidden.en: Check for disagreement that has gone silent without going away. Resentment held back to keep things smooth, or an argument you keep having only with yourself, may be shaping this more than open conflict.
hidden.zh: 查一查有没有只是沉默了、并没有消失的分歧。为了息事宁人而压下的不满，或一场只在你心里反复上演的争论，可能比公开冲突更能左右局面。

self.en: You are stepping back from the fray, tired of friction and ready for peace. Watch whether that is a real choice or a habit of swallowing what you actually think.
self.zh: 你正从混战里往后退，厌倦了摩擦，想要清静。留意这是你真正的选择，还是一种把真实想法咽回去的习惯。

other.en: They appear to be avoiding confrontation. The other person may agree quickly or change the subject, which is likely a wish to keep things calm and not proof that they have no objections.
other.zh: 对方看上去在回避正面冲突，可能很快就附和，或把话题岔开；这多半是想让场面平静，并不代表他们没有异议。

external.en: The competitive pressure around you is easing: rivals are losing interest, the group is tired of arguing, and there is a general appetite for settling things or moving on.
external.zh: 你周围的竞争压力正在松动：对手兴趣渐淡，大家也吵累了，普遍有一种想把事情了结或干脆翻篇的心思。

hopes_fears.en: What you hope for is an end to the tension without another confrontation; what you fear is that keeping quiet means your side of it never gets heard.
hopes_fears.zh: 你想要的，是不必再吵一次就让这份紧张过去；怕的是一直不开口，自己这一方的想法就再也没人听见。

general.en: Conflict is either winding down toward resolution or hiding behind polite avoidance. Step out of noisy drama while staying honest about what still needs settling.
general.zh: 权杖五逆位说明冲突正在走向平息，或被客套回避掩盖。果断退出无谓拉扯，同时对真正需要解决的分歧保持诚实。

love.en: In relationships, reversed Five of Wands signals cooling tempers and making up—or sweeping recurring irritation under the rug. Clear the air gently so peace is real.
love.zh: 在感情中，权杖五逆位既可能意味着火气消退、重归于好，也可能提示把反复出现的不满扫进地毯下。温和把话说透，和解才踏实。

career.en: At work, office politics ease or you decide to opt out of a toxic rivalry. Align on shared deliverables instead of competing for airtime.
career.zh: 在职场上，内耗与办公室拉锯开始缓和，或你决定退出无意义的恶性竞争。把注意力收回到共同交付上。

health.en: Stress and nervous tension are ready to decompress; release clenched shoulders and stop fighting your own need for rest.
health.zh: 在身心状态上，紧绷的压力正等待松绑；松开架起的防备与对抗感，别再和自己对休息的合理需求较劲。

spirituality.en: Inner harmony returns when you stop demanding that every part of yourself agree overnight; practice patient self-acceptance.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，当你不再强求内在所有声音一夜之间达成一致，真正的平和与自我接纳反而会自然浮现。

promptSpec.suitAccent: warm sunlit amber-vermilion, copper-bronze, sprouting emerald leaves, molten antique gold, luminous warm ivory
promptSpec.scene: Five agile Belle Epoque youths in distinct richly colored tunics—vermilion, ochre-gold, deep teal, plum, and indigo with ivory sleeves—engaged in an energetic, spirited sparring contest on an uneven twilight hillside. Each of the FIVE figures grips ONE sprouting bronze-and-wood wand, raising and crossing EXACTLY FIVE distinct wands cleanly at dynamic diagonal angles against a luminous amber-ivory dusk sky so every single wand shaft and emerald-leaved tip is clearly countable and never blurred together. Their faces are vivid, determined, and lively rather than cruel, lit by crisp warm sunset rim-light against deep midnight-indigo hills.

requiredObjects.object: crossed sprouting bronze-and-wood wands held one per figure

promptSpec.compositionNote: Dynamic starburst of FIVE distinct diagonal wands high against bright amber sky above five energetic silhouettes; unmistakable kinetic clash at 64x96 thumbnail.

archetypeEssence.en: Public recognition earned through steady courage—riding into the open with laurel in hand and grace under applause.
archetypeEssence.zh: 凭实力与勇气赢得的公开认可——戴冠入场，在掌声中保持清醒与从容。

en: Victorious rider crowned with a green laurel wreath seated atop a white horse
One upright wand held high bearing a second laurel wreath tied near its tip
Five cheering supporters on foot lifting five wands in salute beside the rider
Flowing bright cloak and proud posture celebrating visible triumph
zh: 头戴月桂冠、骑乘白马从容前行的凯旋骑士
高举在手、梢头系着月桂花环的一根权杖
步随左右、高举五根权杖欢呼致意的支持人群
随风扬起的明艳披风与昂扬身姿，象征公开嘉奖

en: Triumphant Belle Epoque rider wearing an emerald-and-gold laurel crown atop a luminous white steed draped in emerald-and-gold caparison
One prominent sprouting bronze-and-wood wand raised high by the rider with a gleaming golden laurel wreath tied to its upper shaft
Five cheering townsfolk below lifting exactly five upright sprouting wands in salute—six wands total, cleanly countable against the glowing sky
Radiant warm amber-gold victory glow illuminating rider, white horse, and laurel against starry midnight-indigo twilight
zh: 头戴翠叶金桂冠、骑乘披挂金绿鞍饰白马的凯旋美好年代骑士
骑士高举于正中、梢头悬着古金月桂环的一根发芽古铜木杖
身旁欢呼人群举起的五根竖直权杖——共六根权杖，在暖天幕前清晰可数
温暖琥珀金光照亮骑士、白马与桂冠，与深邃午夜蓝天形成耀眼对比

core.en: Six of Wands brings earned victory, visible recognition, and well-deserved confidence. Step forward to accept credit cleanly, share thanks with those who backed you, and let this win fuel your next chapter.
core.zh: 权杖六带来实至名归的胜利、公开认可与舒展自信。大方接住应得的掌声，向同行者致谢，让这次胜利成为下一程的底气。

message.en: Own your win without shrinking—visibility and confidence are part of the work right now.
message.zh: 坦然认领你的成绩，不必刻意缩小自己——被看见与展现笃定，此刻本身就是工作的一部分。

foundation.en: A visible achievement, strong reputation, or past proof of competence opened the door you are walking through.
foundation.zh: 过往一次亮眼战绩、好口碑或经得起检验的实力，为你推开了眼下这扇门。

present.en: Momentum and goodwill are firmly on your side—present your work, lead visibly, and rally support.
present.zh: 势头与人心此刻都站在你这边——大方展示成果、清晰带队，顺势凝聚更多支持。

challenge.en: Applause can turn into complacency, or into needing constant validation just to stay motivated; watch for both.
challenge.zh: 掌声可能变成松懈，也可能养成必须靠外界喝彩才能保持动力的依赖，两者都要提防。

resource.en: Your strongest asset is earned credibility and public trust; people are ready to follow a clear, confident lead.
resource.zh: 你最强的筹码是攒出来的信誉与众人信任；大家已经准备好跟随一个清晰自信的领头人。

action.en: Publish the result, step up to the podium, or claim leadership on the initiative while goodwill is high.
action.zh: 趁口碑与势头正盛，大方公开发布成果、站上台前展示，或正式接过主导权。

outcome.en: This path tends toward clear recognition—a promotion, award, or public endorsement—that is likely to validate your effort and lift your standing.
outcome.zh: 这条路倾向于通往明确的认可——晋升、嘉奖或公开背书，很可能印证你的付出，并把你的位置抬高一阶。

advice.en: Wear the laurel with generosity—thank the crowd walking beside you and keep your feet grounded.
advice.zh: 带着大度戴上桂冠——记住身旁一路相伴的人，在风光时刻依然脚踏实地。

hidden.en: Others may already hold you in higher regard than you know. Check too how much of your drive depends on being seen to win, because that need can steer choices unnoticed.
hidden.zh: 别人对你的评价，也许已经比你知道的更高。同时也看看，你的动力有多少来自“想被人看见自己赢”；这种需要会在不知不觉间左右选择。

self.en: You carry yourself as someone who has delivered and knows it: confident, visible, and comfortable being the one others look to for direction.
self.zh: 你是带着“成绩是我做出来的”这份底气出现的：自信，不怕被看见，也安于做大家望向的那个人。

other.en: They appear confident and well regarded, perhaps fresh from a success. The other person is likely used to being listened to, and may expect their record to speak for them here.
other.zh: 从外表看，对方自信，口碑也不错，也许刚取得一场成功；他们大概习惯了被人倾听，可能指望过往的成绩替自己说话。

external.en: Public opinion is on your side. People are talking about your work favorably, supporters are willing to say so openly, and the audience you need is paying attention.
external.zh: 舆论站在你这一边：人们在正面谈论你的成果，支持你的人愿意公开表态，你需要的那批观众也正看着这里。

hopes_fears.en: You want to be recognized openly for what you have done, and you dread what comes with the attention: higher expectations, envy, and further to fall.
hopes_fears.zh: 你希望自己做成的事能被公开认可；又怕随之而来的关注：更高的期待，旁人的眼红，还有站得越高、摔得越重。

general.en: Victory and recognition arrive after real effort. Stand tall, accept well-earned praise gracefully, and share the warmth with those who supported you.
general.zh: 实打实的努力迎来胜利与公开认可。挺直腰杆大方接住掌声，同时把这份喜悦分享给一路托举你的人。

love.en: In love, Six of Wands brings mutual pride, being openly cherished, and overcoming an awkward hurdle together. Celebrate each other out loud.
love.zh: 在感情中，权杖六代表彼此以对方为傲、大大方方被偏爱与肯定，以及携手跨过磨合后的明朗升温。

career.en: At work, this is classic promotion, launch success, and peer acclaim. Showcase your results clearly and use the credibility to negotiate your next scope.
career.zh: 在工作与学业上，这是典型的晋升、项目大捷与同行赞誉。清晰展示成果，并借这份信誉为下一步争取更好空间。

health.en: Notice and celebrate concrete progress in stamina, recovery, or discipline—positive reinforcement keeps healthy momentum sustainable.
health.zh: 在身心状态上，认真肯定自己在体能、恢复或自律上取得的切实进步——正向反馈会让好状态更长久。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, Six of Wands reminds you that healthy pride and humility can coexist: honor your growth without mistaking applause for your whole identity.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，权杖六提醒健康的自豪与谦逊并不冲突：肯定自己的成长，同时不把外界掌声等同于全部自我。

core.en: Six of Wands reversed highlights self-doubt, delayed recognition, or the fragile ego trap of chasing applause instead of substance.
core.zh: 权杖六逆位指向自我怀疑、认可迟到，或过度执着于外界掌声反而动摇了内在笃定。

blocked.en: Good work is going unnoticed—or imposter syndrome is keeping you from putting it in front of the right eyes.
blocked.zh: 扎实成果暂时没被看见，或冒名顶替感让你迟迟不敢把它推到台前。

excess.en: Performing for status, bragging to mask insecurity, or letting a bruised ego drive poor decisions.
excess.zh: 为了面子强撑排场，或因虚荣与自尊受挫而做出失衡决定。

internalized.en: A quiet private victory that matters deeply to you even without a cheering crowd.
internalized.zh: 一场没有观众喝彩、却对你自己分量十足的内在胜利。

release.en: Unhooking your self-worth from external scoreboards so you can work cleanly again.
release.zh: 把自我价值从外界的打分板上松绑，重新回到纯粹专注做事的状态。

message.en: Your work does not become less real because no one has applauded it yet. Decide what counts as success by your own measure before you look at the crowd again.
message.zh: 你的成果不会因为还没人鼓掌就不算数。先按自己的标准定下什么叫成功，再回头去看台下的反应。

foundation.en: An earlier effort went unacknowledged, or a win felt hollow once you had it. Since then, the question of whether you are seen has weighed more than it should.
foundation.zh: 过去的一次付出没有得到承认，或者一场胜利到手后只觉得空。从那以后，“有没有被看见”这件事，在你心里重得过了头。

present.en: Credit is slow to arrive, and you are reading the silence as a verdict. Your confidence is wavering between hiding the work and overselling it.
present.zh: 该得的认可迟迟没到，你正把这份沉默当成对自己的评判。信心在两头摇摆：要么把成果藏起来，要么把它说得过了头。

challenge.en: Seeking validation from the wrong audience—or doubting your own track record—is draining confidence.
challenge.zh: 向不对口的观众索要掌声，或轻易否定自己过往的实绩，正在消耗底气。

resource.en: You have a record that exists whether or not anyone cheers. Working without applause has also shown you which parts of this you care about for their own sake, and that is steadier fuel.
resource.zh: 不管有没有人喝彩，你做过的成绩都摆在那里。没有掌声的这段日子，也让你看清了哪些部分是你本来就在乎的，这是更稳的动力。

action.en: Document your actual results calmly, ask directly for the credit or feedback you earned, and drop performative busywork.
action.zh: 冷静整理你的真实成果，坦荡争取应得的署名或反馈，同时停掉只为讨好眼球的表面功夫。

outcome.en: External applause may arrive later or quieter than hoped, pushing you to build sturdier self-trust.
outcome.zh: 外界的掌声可能比预期晚来或更低调，但这正促使你建立更牢靠的内在笃定。

advice.en: Measure yourself by the quality of the craft, not the volume of the crowd; real respect follows substance.
advice.zh: 用作品本身的成色而不是围观者的声量来衡量自己；真正的尊重终究追随实力。

hidden.en: Ask how much of this is about the work and how much about being admired for it. A bruised ego, or a fear of being found out as a fraud, may be making decisions you attribute to strategy.
hidden.zh: 问问自己，这里面有多少是为了事情本身，有多少是为了被人佩服。受伤的自尊，或害怕被看穿“名不副实”，可能正替你做着那些你以为出于策略的决定。

self.en: You are downplaying what you have achieved, or working hard to look more successful than you feel. Either way, your sense of worth is leaning on other people's reactions.
self.zh: 你要么在贬低自己已经做到的事，要么在努力显得比心里感觉的更成功。无论哪一种，你的自我价值都靠在别人的反应上。

other.en: The other person appears sensitive to how they are perceived. They may be looking for reassurance or status here, and could be withholding praise from others or fishing for it themselves.
other.zh: 对方似乎很在乎别人怎么看自己，可能正想从这里得到肯定或地位；表现出来的，也许是吝于称赞别人，也许是变着法子求夸奖。

external.en: The spotlight is elsewhere for now. Recognition is delayed, credit is unevenly shared, or the audience is distracted, and none of that is a reliable measure of quality.
external.zh: 聚光灯暂时打在别处。认可来得迟，功劳分得不均，或者观众的注意力不在这里；这些都不能当作衡量水准的可靠尺子。

hopes_fears.en: You hope someone will finally notice what you have done and say so, yet fear that if they look closely they will decide you never deserved the praise.
hopes_fears.zh: 你盼着终于有人注意到你的付出，并且说出来；又怕他们真的看仔细了，会觉得你根本配不上这些夸奖。

general.en: Self-doubt or lack of immediate recognition tests your inner footing. Reconnect with why the work matters to you and let substance outlast hype.
general.zh: 权杖六逆位提示自我怀疑或认可暂未到位，正在考验你的内在定力。回到做事的初衷，让真本事跑赢一时喧嚣。

love.en: In relationships, reversed Six of Wands flags feeling taken for granted, comparing your bond to outsiders, or letting pride block an apology. Speak warmly from honesty, not status.
love.zh: 在感情中，权杖六逆位常对应感到付出被忽略、拿关系与旁人攀比，或放不下架子。放下输赢感，真诚说出需求。

career.en: At work, credit may be delayed or a pitch may fall short of expectations. Review what can be sharpened and make your contributions visible without boasting.
career.zh: 在职场上，功劳可能暂时被埋没或提案未达预期。复盘可打磨之处，用清晰客观的方式让关键人看见你的产出。

health.en: Avoid chasing vanity metrics or pushing past safe limits to prove a point; honor quiet, unglamorous consistency.
health.zh: 在身心管理上，避免为了证明自己而追求浮夸指标或过度透支；踏实、低调的日常坚持才最有效。

spirituality.en: Release the hunger to be admired for your progress; genuine maturity grows fastest when nobody is watching.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，放下渴望被夸赞“修得好”的虚荣；真正扎实的成长，往往发生在无人喝彩的安静处。
