archetypeEssence.en: Holding the high ground under pressure—courageous defense of your convictions when challengers press from below.
archetypeEssence.zh: 压力环伺下稳守高地——面对四面涌来的质疑与挑战，依然寸步不让地捍卫核心立场。

en: Resolute figure planted on a steep rocky ridge defending the high ground
One sprouting wand gripped firmly with both hands in active defense
Six wands thrusting upward from below the ridge representing rival pressures
Mismatched boots or hurried footing showing readiness despite being caught mid-stride
zh: 稳立于陡峭岩脊高地、迎击来势的坚定守卫者
双手紧握横挡的一根发芽权杖
自坡下齐齐刺上的六根权杖，象征多方压力与挑战
匆忙却依然稳健的步态，体现仓促应战而不乱阵脚

en: Determined Belle Epoque defender in emerald-and-bronze tunic braced atop a dramatic sunlit rocky ridge
One sprouting bronze-and-wood wand held diagonally across the body with both hands in crisp defensive stance
Exactly six rival sprouting wands rising sharply from the midnight shadows below the cliff edge—seven wands total, clearly separated against the glowing dusk sky
Dramatic warm amber-vermilion key light on the defender's high ground contrasting with deep indigo twilight below
zh: 身穿祖母绿与古铜色短袍、稳踞陡峭暖光岩脊的美好年代守卫者
双手斜握护身、姿态利落的一根发芽古铜木杖
自崖下午夜阴影中刺出的六根对手权杖——共七根权杖，在暖暮天幕前根根分明
高地暖琥珀主光与崖下深靛蓝暗影形成强烈压迫与守势对比

core.en: Seven of Wands shows you holding the high ground while multiple pressures test your resolve. You have earned your position—stand firm, prioritize what truly matters, and don't yield to noise.
core.zh: 权杖七显示你正守在高地上，同时承受多方压力与试探。你站的位置是凭实力挣来的——稳住底线、分清主次，不必在嘈杂中轻易退让。

message.en: Hold your line with calm grit; you actually hold the stronger vantage point than the pressure makes it feel.
message.zh: 带着沉着韧劲守住你的底线；你实际占据的高地优势，比当下压力让你感受到的更牢靠。

foundation.en: A recent win or clear stance attracted scrutiny, competition, or people testing whether you meant what you said.
foundation.zh: 此前的亮眼表现或明确表态引来了审视、竞争，或有人想试试你的底线究竟有多硬。

present.en: Demands are coming from several angles at once; stay planted on your core principle instead of scattering.
present.zh: 多个方向的要求与质疑正同时压来；死死锚定最核心的原则，别被拖散阵脚。

challenge.en: The trap is treating every question as an attack—defend what matters, not every trivial point.
challenge.zh: 陷阱在于把每句提问都当成攻击——只守关键阵地，不必在每个细枝末节上都竖起刺。

resource.en: Your strongest asset is moral and strategic high ground—conviction backed by preparation outlasts noisy challengers.
resource.zh: 你最强的优势是道义与战略高地——有准备支撑的笃定感，终究能熬过喧闹的挑衅。

action.en: State your boundary clearly once, back it with facts, and hold steady through the pushback.
action.zh: 把你的边界干脆利落地说清一次，用事实托底，然后在反弹来临时稳稳站住。

outcome.en: If you keep holding steady, perseverance is likely to pay off: you keep your ground, earn grudging respect, and come out with firmer authority.
outcome.zh: 若能继续稳稳守住，坚持很可能换来回报：守住阵地，赢得对方虽不情愿却不得不给的尊重，并立起更稳固的话语权。

advice.en: Keep your footing high and your breath steady—defensive courage works best when it is calm, not frantic.
advice.zh: 守稳高处立足点、放平呼吸——冷静沉着的防守，远比慌乱挥棒更有力量。

hidden.en: Check how much of the pressure is actual opposition and how much is anticipation. Your position may be stronger, and your challengers less coordinated, than it looks from where you stand.
hidden.zh: 分辨一下，这些压力里有多少是真实的反对，有多少只是你的预想。你的位置也许比站在上面看起来更稳，挑战你的人也未必那么齐心。

self.en: You show up braced and resolute: sure of what you stand for, unwilling to be pushed off it, and ready to defend your position even when caught off guard.
self.zh: 你是绷紧了、下定决心来的：清楚自己坚持什么，不肯被人推开，哪怕措手不及，也准备守住自己的位置。

other.en: The other party appears to be on the defensive. They are likely guarding a position they feel they earned, and may treat your questions as challenges even when you mean none.
other.zh: 对方看上去处于守势，很可能在护着一个自认为凭本事挣来的位置；哪怕你并无此意，他们也可能把你的提问当成挑战。

external.en: You face pushback from several directions: competitors, critics, or people who want what you hold. The environment is testing your position and offering no favors.
external.zh: 反对的力量来自好几个方向：竞争者、批评者，或是想要你手里东西的人。环境正在考验你的位置，不会给你行方便。

hopes_fears.en: You hope to prove you can hold your ground alone against the odds, yet fear that one more push will be the one that finally dislodges you.
hopes_fears.zh: 你希望证明，即使寡不敌众，自己一个人也守得住；又怕再来一次冲击，就是终于把你推下去的那一下。

general.en: Defense and perseverance are called for as competing pressures rise. Trust your vantage point, hold your boundaries firmly, and keep your energy focused.
general.zh: 多方压力涌来时，需要果断防守与持久韧劲。相信你脚下的高地优势，稳守清晰边界，把精力集中在关键处。

love.en: In love, Seven of Wands can mean protecting a relationship from outside interference, or holding an honest personal boundary even when it feels uncomfortable.
love.zh: 在感情中，权杖七既可能意味着守护关系免受外界干扰，也代表在不舒服时依然稳稳守住自己的真实底线。

career.en: At work, defend your strategy, pricing, or team bandwidth against scope creep and rival pitches. Preparation and clear criteria win the room.
career.zh: 在职场上，坚定守住你的方案、报价或团队带宽，抵御需求蔓延与对手抢位。充分准备与清晰标准会帮你赢下全场。

health.en: Protect your recovery time and healthy habits from competing demands—saying no to extra strain is active self-defense.
health.zh: 在身心管理上，把你的休息时间与好习惯从各种挤占中护出来——对多余负荷说不，就是最实在的自我保护。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, Seven of Wands strengthens inner integrity: staying true to your values when convenience pulls the other way builds real backbone.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，权杖七锤炼的是内在骨气：在外界拉扯与权宜诱惑面前依然忠于核心价值，会让你真正长出定力。

core.en: Seven of Wands reversed points to feeling overwhelmed by constant defense, yielding too quickly, or realizing a battle is no longer worth the cost of fighting.
core.zh: 权杖七逆位指向持续迎战带来的精疲力竭、过早退让，或终于意识到某场拉锯战已经不值得继续赔上心力。

blocked.en: Self-doubt or exhaustion makes you drop a healthy boundary right when you need it most.
blocked.zh: 自我怀疑或疲惫让你在最需要守住的关头，过早松开了合理边界。

excess.en: Hyper-defensiveness—fighting phantom enemies or refusing helpful compromise out of sheer stubbornness.
excess.zh: 过度戒备与好斗——把善意建议也当成进攻，仅凭执拗拒绝原本有益的妥协。

internalized.en: Feeling cornered inside your own head, bracing for criticism before anyone has spoken.
internalized.zh: 别人还没开口，心里已经把自己逼到墙角，提前摆出了全面防御姿势。

release.en: Choosing to lay down a draining battle so you can redirect energy to fertile ground.
release.zh: 清醒选择放下这场消耗极大的硬仗，把力气转回真正值得耕耘的地方。

message.en: You do not have to defend every position you have ever taken. Decide which ground still matters to you, and let the rest go without calling it a loss.
message.zh: 你不必守住自己表过态的每一个立场。想清楚哪块阵地对你仍然重要，其余的放手，也不用把它叫作输。

foundation.en: A long stretch of fending off criticism or competition came before this. Somewhere along the way, defending yourself turned from a response into a reflex.
foundation.zh: 在这之前，你经历了很长一段抵挡批评或竞争的日子。不知从哪一刻起，为自己辩护从一种应对变成了条件反射。

present.en: Your guard is slipping. You are giving way on points you would once have argued, or still swinging at challenges that have stopped coming.
present.zh: 你的防线正在松动。有些以前会据理力争的地方，你开始让步了；或者，你还在朝早已不再袭来的挑战挥着棒子。

challenge.en: Battle fatigue or fighting on too many fronts at once is eroding your clarity and stamina.
challenge.zh: 久战疲惫或同时在太多战线上应战，正在快速消耗你的清醒与体力。

resource.en: Holding out this long has taught you your real limits and which principles you will not trade. Yielding what matters little frees strength for what matters most, and that choice is still yours.
resource.zh: 撑了这么久，你已经清楚自己真正的极限，也知道哪些原则绝不拿去交换。让出无关紧要的部分，能把力气腾给最要紧的，而怎么选仍在你手里。

action.en: Step back from unwinnable arguments, accept one fair compromise, or ask an ally to share the watch.
action.zh: 主动撤出毫无胜算的消耗战，接纳一项公平妥协，或请可靠盟友替你分担守卫。

outcome.en: Tension drops once you stop defending every inch—either through smart strategic retreat or cleaner terms.
outcome.zh: 当你不再执着于寸土必争，紧绷感会迅速回落——无论是战略撤退还是重新谈妥条件，都会迎来喘息。

advice.en: Pick your battles with ruthless honesty; surrendering an unimportant hill is not defeat.
advice.zh: 诚实筛选值得打的仗；主动让出一座无关紧要的小山头，绝不等于失败。

hidden.en: Consider whether you are bracing for an attack no one has launched. It is also worth asking if you still believe in the position, or only in not backing down.
hidden.zh: 想一想，你是不是在防备一场根本没人发起的进攻。也值得问问自己，你仍然相信这个立场，还是只是不想退。

self.en: You are worn thin and on edge: quick to feel criticized, unsure whether to dig in or step down, and carrying the whole defense by yourself.
self.zh: 你已经被磨得很薄，神经紧绷：动不动就觉得被批评，拿不准该死守还是该退下，而这场防守一直是你一个人在扛。

other.en: They may be tired of holding their line. The other person appears either unusually prickly or suddenly willing to concede, and both are likely signs of fatigue more than a change of heart.
other.zh: 对方可能已经守得累了，表现为格外带刺，或者突然愿意让步；这两种多半都是疲惫的信号，未必是想法变了。

external.en: The pressure from outside is relentless or badly timed, coming faster than one person can answer. The odds here may simply be uneven, whatever your resolve.
external.zh: 外来的压力一波接一波，或者来得很不是时候，快得一个人根本应付不过来。无论你多坚决，这里的力量对比可能本来就不对等。

hopes_fears.en: Part of you hopes to put the fight down and finally breathe; another part fears that standing down will be read as weakness and invite people to take more.
hopes_fears.zh: 你一面希望能放下这场仗，终于喘口气；一面又怕一退下来就被看成软弱，引得别人得寸进尺。

general.en: Overwhelm or battle fatigue asks you to reassess which hills actually matter. Drop defensive reflexes where compromise serves you better.
general.zh: 权杖七逆位提示过度防御或疲惫感正在累积，需要重新评估哪些阵地真正值得守。在适合协商之处松开硬扛。

love.en: In relationships, reversed Seven of Wands flags either exhausting bickering or giving in to keep peace while resentment builds. Lower the armor and talk plainly.
love.zh: 在感情中，权杖七逆位常对应疲于争辩，或为了息事宁人一味退让却暗生委屈。先卸下铠甲，平心静气把话说开。

career.en: At work, you may feel outgunned or worn down by constant pushback. Narrow your focus to one non-negotiable priority and let minor turf wars go.
career.zh: 在职场上，你可能感到四面受压或被反复拉扯耗尽耐心。只守住最关键的一项核心目标，其余枝节果断放手。

health.en: Chronic stress from staying constantly on guard wears down immunity and sleep; step off the ridge and give your nervous system real off-duty time.
health.zh: 在身心状态上，长期处于戒备与应激状态会暗中透支精力与睡眠；暂时走下高地，给神经系统真正的下班时间。

spirituality.en: Notice where you are defending an outdated self-image; letting your guard down opens space for unexpected grace and support.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，觉察自己是否在死守一个早已过时的自我形象；适当放下戒备，反而会迎来意想不到的滋养与支持。

promptSpec.suitAccent: warm sunlit amber-vermilion, copper-bronze, sprouting emerald leaves, molten antique gold, luminous warm ivory
promptSpec.scene: A resolute Belle Epoque defender in a richly textured emerald-and-bronze tunic with warm ivory sleeves braced firmly atop a jagged rocky ridge. Leaning into a crisp defensive stance, they grip ONE sprouting bronze-and-wood wand diagonally with both hands across their body. Thrusting upward from the deep midnight-indigo shadows below the cliff edge are EXACTLY SIX rival sprouting bronze-and-wood wands angled sharply toward the ridge—EXACTLY SEVEN wands total, every single shaft and emerald-leaved tip cleanly separated and countable against the glowing amber-vermilion twilight sky. Warm dramatic rim-light illuminates the defender's face, braced stance, and high rocky perch.

requiredObjects.object: defender braced on high rocky ridge
sprouting bronze-and-wood wands total (1 held by defender + 6 thrusting from below)

promptSpec.compositionNote: High-contrast elevated defender holding ONE diagonal wand against SIX clearly spaced rival wands rising from the lower border; reads cleanly at 64x96 thumbnail.

archetypeEssence.en: Unobstructed velocity—messages, decisions, and aligned events racing cleanly toward landing.
archetypeEssence.zh: 毫无阻滞的疾驰势头——消息、决策与契机齐头并进，正笔直飞向落点。

en: Eight sprouting wooden wands flying in parallel diagonal formation across an open sky
No human figures blocking the frame, emphasizing pure swift motion
Winding river and lush sunlit valley stretching far below
All eight staves angled downward together toward an imminent landing
zh: 以整齐平行斜阵划过澄澈长空的八根发芽木杖
画面中无人物阻挡，纯粹呈现疾速流动的势能
下方蜿蜒流淌的河流与开阔河谷
齐齐指向下方落点、即将着陆的八根权杖

en: Exactly eight slender sprouting bronze-and-wood wands flying cleanly in parallel diagonal formation from upper-left to lower-right
Trailing streaks of warm molten-gold light and drifting emerald leaves behind each airborne wand
Expansive sunlit amber-vermilion horizon opening above a moonlit winding river valley and distant hills
Generous midnight-indigo sky spacing so every single one of the eight parallel wands reads unmistakably
zh: 自左上向右下方整齐平行飞驰、清晰可数的八根发芽古铜木杖
每根权杖尾端拖曳的暖金流光与飘散翠叶
下方蜿蜒的月光河谷与远方暖金地平线
深邃午夜蓝天留白充裕，令八根平行权杖根根分明

core.en: Eight of Wands signals rapid movement, crisp communication, and cleared skies. The slow waiting phase is over—respond promptly while the tailwind is directly behind you.
core.zh: 权杖八标志着疾速推进、清晰传讯与豁然开朗的顺风局。漫长等待已经结束——趁顺风正盛，干脆利落地接招响应。

message.en: Move now while the air is clear—a timely reply, launch, or decision will carry twice the usual distance.
message.zh: 趁眼下空气澄明立刻出手——一次及时的回复、发布或拍板，能跑出平时两倍的推进效率。

foundation.en: Earlier preparation cleared away the obstacles, which is why everything suddenly accelerated at once.
foundation.zh: 前期的铺垫已经把障碍清干净了，所以此刻诸多环节才一下子同时提速。

present.en: Events, messages, and travel or logistics are converging quickly; stay alert and keep your channels open.
present.zh: 事件、消息与出行或后勤安排正在快速汇拢；保持敏锐，让各条通道随时畅通。

challenge.en: A pace this fast can leave out the quick sanity check that catches mistakes—stay swift, not sloppy.
challenge.zh: 节奏这么快，容易漏掉那一步能拦住差错的快速复核——要利落，但别草率。

resource.en: Your strongest asset is speed and alignment—when all eight wands fly the same angle, nothing is wasted.
resource.zh: 你最强的优势是速度与同向合力——当八根权杖朝同一角度齐飞，几乎没有任何内耗。

action.en: Send the message, book the trip, ship the release, or lock the date today before the window shifts.
action.zh: 今天就把消息发出去、把行程定下来或把版本推上线，别等顺风窗口滑过去。

outcome.en: With this tailwind, things tend toward swift resolution, welcome news, or rapid progress that lands cleanly without drawn-out friction.
outcome.zh: 顺着这股风势，事情倾向于利落解决、传来好消息或快速推进，干净落地而少有漫长拉锯。

advice.en: Match the tempo of the moment—keep your aim straight and let momentum do the heavy lifting.
advice.zh: 顺着当下的快节奏走——稳住准星，让势头替你完成最吃力的那段推进。

hidden.en: More may already be in motion than you have been told. Check your inbox and your assumptions: a decision or message could be on its way before you have finished preparing for it.
hidden.zh: 已经动起来的事情，可能比你被告知的更多。查查收件箱，也核对一下自己的预设：某个决定或消息，也许在你准备好之前就已经在路上了。

self.en: You are moving fast and thinking in straight lines: responsive, decisive, and impatient with anything that slows a clear run toward the target.
self.zh: 你行动迅速，思路笔直：反应快，决断也快，对任何拖慢你直奔目标的东西都没什么耐心。

other.en: Speed is what shows on the other side: they appear to move quickly and communicate directly, are likely to reply fast and expect the same, and may press for a decision sooner than you planned.
other.zh: 对方那边给人的印象就是快：动作利落，沟通直接，回复大概也很迅速，并期待你同样如此，可能会比你计划的更早催你做决定。

external.en: Events are accelerating around you: news arrives in clusters, schedules compress, and obstacles that held things up have cleared. The pace is being set outside you.
external.zh: 周围的事情都在提速：消息扎堆到来，日程被压紧，此前挡路的障碍也清掉了。节奏是由外部定的，不由你。

hopes_fears.en: You hope everything finally moves and the answer arrives soon, yet fear that it is all happening too fast for you to steer or to take back.
hopes_fears.zh: 你盼着一切终于动起来，答案快点到；又怕事情发展得太快，快到你来不及掌舵，也来不及反悔。

general.en: Speed, movement, and clear momentum sweep away recent stagnation. Expect swift news, travel, or rapid alignment—stay ready to catch what lands.
general.zh: 高速推进与清晰势头一扫此前的停滞感。近期容易迎来快讯、出行或迅速对齐的进展，随时准备好稳稳接住。

love.en: In love, Eight of Wands brings rapid chemistry, eager messages, spontaneous getaways, or a relationship suddenly clicking into lively motion.
love.zh: 在感情中，权杖八带来迅速升温的默契、热烈频繁的联系、说走就走的约会，或关系突然进入明快推进期。

career.en: At work, approvals clear fast, projects hit stride, and concise communication unlocks quick wins. Keep your inbox and deliverables crisp.
career.zh: 在工作上，审批与协作明显提速，项目进入顺滑快车道。保持沟通简明扼要、交付利落，能顺势拿下漂亮成果。

health.en: Energy rebounds briskly and recovery accelerates; enjoy the surge while remembering to pace your nervous system between sprints.
health.zh: 在身心状态上，精力回升明快、恢复提速；享受这股轻盈劲头的同时，别忘了在冲刺间隙给神经留出缓冲。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, Eight of Wands brings sudden insight and synchronicity—trust clear intuition when it arrives without over-complicating it.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，权杖八带来通透的顿悟与巧合呼应——当清晰的直觉降临时，直接信任并顺势接纳即可。

core.en: Eight of Wands reversed signals delays, crossed wires, or rushing so hard that messages and plans miss their landing.
core.zh: 权杖八逆位提示节奏受阻、沟通错位，或因为太急着赶路而让消息与计划偏离落点。

blocked.en: Travel snags, slow replies, or bottlenecks are temporarily stalling momentum.
blocked.zh: 行程延误、回复迟滞或流程卡点，暂时拖住了原本顺畅的势头。

excess.en: Frenetic haste—sending half-baked messages or firing off too many priorities at once.
excess.zh: 焦躁冒进——仓促发出没想清楚的消息，或同时抛出太多杂乱动作。

internalized.en: Restless impatience inside even when external timing simply needs another beat.
internalized.zh: 明明外界时机只差半拍，内心却已经焦躁得坐立难安。

release.en: Slowing down on purpose to untangle miscommunication so the next launch flies straight.
release.zh: 主动降速理清误会与杂线，让下一次出发真正飞得又直又稳。

message.en: Speed is not the problem to solve here; aim is. Take the extra beat to confirm what was actually said and agreed before you send the next thing.
message.zh: 眼下要解决的不是速度，而是准头。多花半拍，确认对方到底说了什么、双方到底约定了什么，再发下一条。

foundation.en: This traces back to something sent in a hurry or received garbled: a message misread, a plan launched before everyone was aligned, or momentum that stalled mid-flight.
foundation.zh: 事情要追溯到某次匆忙发出或传走了样的沟通：一条被误读的消息，一个大家还没对齐就启动的计划，或是飞到半途失了速的势头。

present.en: Things are arriving late, out of order, or not at all. You are waiting on replies while fielding confusion about what was meant, and the urge to push harder is strong.
present.zh: 该来的东西不是迟到、顺序错乱，就是干脆没来。你一边等回复，一边应付“到底是什么意思”的混乱，很想再加把劲硬推。

challenge.en: Miscommunication, mixed signals, or impatient shortcuts are causing avoidable rework.
challenge.zh: 传话失真、信号混乱或心急抄近道，正在造成本可避免的返工。

resource.en: The slowdown gives you time you would not otherwise have had to reread, correct, and reorder before anything lands. Mistakes caught mid-air cost far less than ones caught on arrival.
resource.zh: 这次放慢给了你原本没有的时间，可以在事情落地前重读、修正、重新排序。在半空中发现的错，代价远小于落地后才发现的。

action.en: Double-check dates, recipients, and details before hitting send, and pause one rushed move to confirm alignment.
action.zh: 点发送前再次核对时间、对象与关键细节，先叫停一个过于仓促的动作以确认对齐。

outcome.en: Progress is still likely to come, just on a slower or staggered schedule that rewards careful follow-through.
outcome.zh: 进展多半仍会到来，只是节奏放慢或分批落地，更看重你稳健细致的跟进。

advice.en: Slow is smooth and smooth is fast—untangle the wires before pressing the accelerator again.
advice.zh: 慢即是稳、稳即是快——先把缠住的线理顺，再重新踩下油门。

hidden.en: Look for a message that did not land the way you assume. Something you believe was communicated may never have been received, or may have been understood quite differently.
hidden.zh: 找一找有没有哪条消息并没有像你以为的那样送达。你认定已经传达的内容，对方可能根本没收到，或者理解得完全不同。

self.en: You are restless and ahead of yourself: refreshing for updates, answering before you have read to the end, and treating a short wait as a sign that something is wrong.
self.zh: 你坐立不安，心思跑在了事情前面：不停刷新看有没有进展，没读完就急着回，把短暂的等待当成出了问题的信号。

other.en: Slow answers or mixed signals may be coming from the other party. This appears more likely to be distraction, overload, or a muddled message than a deliberate stalling tactic.
other.zh: 对方可能回得慢，或给出的信号前后不一；这看上去更像是分心、事情太多或话没说清，而不是故意拖着你。

external.en: Timing is working against a clean run: transport delays, backlogs, time zones, or technical hiccups are breaking up the flow, and these are outside your control.
external.zh: 时机不利于一气呵成：交通延误、事务积压、时差或技术小故障把节奏打断了，而这些都不在你的掌控之内。

hopes_fears.en: The hope is that the delay means nothing and the reply is simply on its way; the fear is that the silence is itself the answer, or that your message came out wrong.
hopes_fears.zh: 你希望这次延迟不代表什么，回复只是还在路上；怕的是沉默本身就是答案，或者自己发出去的话走了样。

general.en: Delays and miscommunication ask you to slow down and verify details. Catching a crossed wire now saves far more time than rushing blindly.
general.zh: 权杖八逆位提示延迟与沟通错位，适合主动放慢半拍核对细节。现在理清一条错线，比盲目狂奔省力得多。

love.en: In relationships, reversed Eight of Wands flags text misunderstandings, mismatched timing, or moving too fast before trust catches up. Clarify tone directly.
love.zh: 在感情中，权杖八逆位常见于文字误会、行程错开或推进太快导致情绪没跟上。直接把语气与心意说清最管用。

career.en: At work, expect scheduling hiccups, delayed feedback, or chaotic email threads. Summarize decisions in writing and confirm who owns the next step.
career.zh: 在职场上，可能出现排期变动、反馈延迟或冗长混乱的邮件往来。把结论简明落到文字里，确认下一步负责人。

health.en: Wired-but-tired restlessness signals overstimulation; step away from rapid notifications and let your tempo settle.
health.zh: 在身心状态上，焦躁却疲惫的感觉说明信息与节奏过载；暂时远离高频消息刺激，让呼吸与心率慢下来。

spirituality.en: A pause in outer momentum is an invitation to listen inward rather than forcing signs on your own timetable.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，外在节奏暂缓恰好邀请你向内倾听，不必按自己的焦急时间表硬催宇宙给答案。

promptSpec.suitAccent: warm sunlit amber-vermilion, copper-bronze, sprouting emerald leaves, molten antique gold, luminous warm ivory
promptSpec.scene: An exhilarating, figure-free Belle Epoque skyscape showing EXACTLY EIGHT identical slender carved wooden-and-bronze wands flying cleanly in parallel diagonal formation from upper-left toward lower-right, descending toward a sunlit twilight valley below. All EIGHT wands are solid, sharply outlined wooden staves sprouting tiny emerald leaves, stacked evenly from top to bottom with generous open sky separating every single shaft so all eight staves are effortlessly countable at a glance. Below the eight soaring wands stretches a serene winding gilded river, lush dark emerald cypress hills, and a warm glowing sunrise horizon.

requiredObjects.object: solid carved wooden-and-bronze sprouting wands flying diagonally in parallel

promptSpec.compositionNote: Clean, evenly stacked diagonal array of EXACTLY EIGHT solid wooden wands (arranged in two neat flights of four or one crisp even ladder of eight) slicing across clear midnight-and-amber sky well inside the upper and lower safe margins, with zero decorative ribbons or extra floating streaks.

archetypeEssence.en: Battle-tested resilience on the final watch—wary and bruised, yet still standing with boundaries intact.
archetypeEssence.zh: 历经风霜后的最后坚守——虽带疲惫与旧伤，却依然稳稳立住防线与底气。

en: Weary, bandaged figure leaning upright on one sprouting wooden wand
Eight tall sprouting wands planted upright in a tight defensive palisade behind the figure
Watchful sidelong glance scanning the horizon for one more test
Worn posture showing hard-won endurance near the end of a long campaign
zh: 额缠绷带、手扶一根发芽木杖稳稳站立的疲惫守望者
身后整齐排成一道坚固木栅栏的八根竖直权杖
警觉斜望远方的眼神，防备最后一轮考验
饱经风霜却依然不倒的身姿，象征长途跋涉后的顽强韧性

en: Weathered Belle Epoque sentinel with a neat pale ivory bandage wrapped around their brow, leaning steadily on one upright sprouting bronze-and-wood wand
Exactly eight upright sprouting bronze-and-wood wands standing in a clean, evenly spaced defensive palisade directly behind them—nine wands total
Alert, resilient gaze turned watchfully toward the glowing amber twilight horizon
Warm amber-vermilion rim-light carving the sentinel's brow bandage, hands, and all nine vertical wands out of deep midnight-indigo shadows
zh: 额前缠着素白绷带、双手稳扶一根发芽古铜木杖的美好年代守夜人
身后整齐列阵如防线的八根竖立发芽权杖——共九根权杖，间距清晰可数
望向暮色远方的警觉而坚韧的目光
暖琥珀轮廓光在深邃午夜暗影中勾勒出绷带、双手与九根权杖的挺拔线条

core.en: Nine of Wands honors hard-won grit: you have survived previous rounds, learned where the cracks are, and still have enough left in the tank to finish strong—just remember to protect your energy while holding the line.
core.zh: 权杖九致敬历经考验的硬核韧性：你已经扛过了前几轮风浪，摸清了防线薄弱处，手里依然留有走完最后一段的余力——守好边界，同时别忘了保存体力。

message.en: You are closer to the finish than fatigue makes it feel—hold your boundaries, pace yourself, and see this last stretch through.
message.zh: 你离终点比疲惫让你感受到的更近——稳住防线、调好呼吸，把这最后一段稳稳走完。

foundation.en: Earlier setbacks or demanding battles left you wiser, tougher, and rightly careful about who gets past your fence.
foundation.zh: 过往的磕碰与硬仗让你更清醒、更抗打，也让你对谁能越过防线格外谨慎。

present.en: Energy is running lean and your guard is up, yet your structure is solid and you still hold the field.
present.zh: 精力所剩不多、戒心也提着，但你的防线依然稳固，阵地仍在你手里。

challenge.en: Old bruises can make you brace against allies as if they were enemies, keeping real help on the wrong side of the fence.
challenge.zh: 旧伤可能让你把同路人当成对手来防，连真正来帮忙的人也被挡在栅栏外。

resource.en: Your strongest asset is lived experience and endurance—nothing about this terrain can surprise you anymore.
resource.zh: 你最宝贵的资源是实战沉淀下来的经验与耐力——这片地形里已经没什么能让你措手不及。

action.en: Keep your essential boundary firm, conserve stamina for the final milestone, and let one trusted check-in reassure you.
action.zh: 守住最关键的那道边界，把体力留给最后一个节点，再找一位信得过的人对一对情况，让自己安下心来。

outcome.en: If you pace what strength remains, quiet, earned endurance is likely to carry you across the finish line with your integrity and hard-won gains intact.
outcome.zh: 只要分配好余力，这份沉稳而顽强的坚持很可能带你冲过终点，把辛苦攒下的成果与尊严完整守住。

advice.en: Respect your scars without living inside them—stay alert, not permanently braced for war.
advice.zh: 尊重过往的伤疤，但不必一直活在战备状态里——保持清醒警觉，而非时刻紧绷。

hidden.en: Verify that the next blow you are bracing for is actually coming. Old injuries may be setting your level of alarm, and you may have more reserves left than you are counting.
hidden.zh: 核实一下，你防着的下一击是否真的要来。定下你警戒级别的可能是旧伤；而你剩下的余力，也可能比自己算的多。

self.en: You show up tired but upright: guarded, experienced, and determined to see this through because you have come too far to stop.
self.zh: 你带着疲惫，却依然站得笔直：有戒心，有经验，也决心把这件事走完，因为已经走了这么远，不想停在这里。

other.en: Wariness is what shows on their side. The other person appears slow to trust, has likely been through something hard, and may be guarding themselves more than opposing you.
other.zh: 对方流露出的是戒备，不轻易信任人；他们很可能经历过不容易的事，这份防备或许更多是自我保护，而不是在跟你作对。

external.en: The situation still demands vigilance. One more test, deadline, or round of scrutiny is likely before this is over, and little outside relief is on offer in the meantime.
external.zh: 局面仍然需要你保持警惕。在事情结束之前，很可能还有一次考验、一个期限或一轮审视，而这期间外界能给的援手不多。

hopes_fears.en: You hope you have enough left to hold out until the end, yet fear that the next setback will be the one you cannot absorb.
hopes_fears.zh: 你希望剩下的力气足够撑到最后；又怕下一次挫折，就是自己再也扛不住的那一次。

general.en: Resilience and firm boundaries carry you through the final stretch. You have already weathered the hardest parts—pace your remaining strength wisely.
general.zh: 韧性与清晰边界正托着你走完最后一段。最难的关口其实已经挺过来了——聪明地分配余力，稳稳收尾。

love.en: In love, Nine of Wands reflects cautious trust after past hurt, or standing steady through a rough patch together. Keep healthy boundaries without locking out genuine warmth.
love.zh: 在感情中，权杖九常反映旧伤之后的谨慎试探，或携手熬过磨合低谷的坚持。守住边界，但别把真诚的暖意也关在门外。

career.en: At work, you are in the late innings of a demanding project. Protect your team's bandwidth, rely on proven checklists, and push cleanly over the finish line.
career.zh: 在职场上，你正处于高强度项目的收官阶段。护住精力带宽，靠验证过的流程稳步推进，把最后一步扎扎实实做完。

health.en: Fatigue is real even when willpower is strong; honor recovery, tend to lingering strain, and avoid pushing past your body's warning signals.
health.zh: 在身心状态上，意志再强也掩盖不了真实的疲惫；认真照料旧劳损，别再无视身体发出的休息信号。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, Nine of Wands is steadfastness: wisdom grows not from never being bruised, but from staying present and kind even when tired.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，权杖九代表历劫不磨的定力：真正的智慧不是从未受伤，而是疲惫时依然守得住清明与善意。

core.en: Nine of Wands reversed points to bone-deep exhaustion, paranoid hyper-vigilance, or finally deciding to put down an unsustainable guard and ask for backup.
core.zh: 权杖九逆位指向透支已久的疲惫、草木皆兵的过度防备，或终于决定卸下撑不住的孤军坚守、主动求助。

blocked.en: Stubbornly refusing help because you assume nobody else will hold the line properly.
blocked.zh: 固执地拒绝援手，总觉得别人接手就守不住，结果把自己困死在岗哨上。

excess.en: Paranoia and mistrust—seeing threats behind every neutral remark or minor delay.
excess.zh: 草木皆兵与过度猜疑——把寻常客套或小延误都解读成恶意针对。

internalized.en: Quiet burnout hiding behind a tough exterior that says 'I'm fine.'
internalized.zh: 嘴上硬撑着说“没事”，内在其实已经快被长期紧绷掏空。

release.en: Lowering defensive walls where the danger has already passed so real rest can begin.
release.zh: 在危险早已过去的地方主动撤下高墙，让真正的休养与松弛开始。

message.en: The watch you are keeping now costs more than the danger warrants. Find out which threats are still real, and stand down from the rest.
message.zh: 你一直守着的这班岗，付出的代价已经超过了危险本身。弄清哪些威胁仍然存在，其余的，可以撤岗了。

foundation.en: You spent a long time on guard with no one to relieve you. What began as sensible caution after being hurt hardened into a habit of expecting the worst.
foundation.zh: 你独自站了很久的岗，没有人来替换。受过伤之后合情合理的那份谨慎，慢慢硬成了凡事先往最坏处想的习惯。

present.en: You are running on empty and still refusing to sit down. Small things feel like threats, and you answer “I'm fine” before anyone finishes asking.
present.zh: 你早已精疲力尽，却还是不肯坐下来。一点小事都像威胁，别人话还没问完，你就先答了一句“我没事”。

challenge.en: Exhaustion and defensive suspicion are distorting your judgment and draining the last of your reserves.
challenge.zh: 过度透支与习惯性防备正在扭曲判断，把你最后一点精力储备也消耗殆尽。

resource.en: The defenses you built are still there and can hold for a while without you. People who would take a turn do exist, and telling real danger from false alarm is a skill you have earned.
resource.zh: 你筑起的防线还在，没有你盯着也能撑上一阵。愿意替你守一班的人是有的，而分辨真危险与虚惊的本事，是你一路挣来的。

action.en: Step off watch for a real break, delegate one recurring worry, and test whether a perceived threat is actually real.
action.zh: 立刻安排一次真正的休整，把一件反复消耗你的担子分出去，并核实眼前的危机究竟是真实还是惯性焦虑。

outcome.en: Relief arrives once you stop fighting solo; dropping unnecessary armor restores both clarity and stamina.
outcome.zh: 当你不再孤军硬扛，松弛感会迅速回来；卸下多余铠甲反而能更快找回清醒与体力。

advice.en: Rest is not surrender—let someone else take a shift before fatigue makes your decisions for you.
advice.zh: 休息绝不是认输——在疲惫替你做决定之前，先让信得过的人替你值一班。

hidden.en: Ask whether you are more depleted than you admit. A refusal to accept help may rest on an untested belief that no one else can be trusted to hold the line.
hidden.zh: 问问自己，是不是比嘴上承认的更透支。不肯接受帮助的背后，可能是一个从没验证过的想法：除了你，谁也守不住。

self.en: You come across as armored and worn out: suspicious of offers, reluctant to show strain, and convinced that if you let go for a moment everything will fall.
self.zh: 你给人的样子是一身铠甲又疲惫不堪：对别人的好意存疑，不愿显出吃力，并且深信自己只要松手片刻，一切就会垮掉。

other.en: Exhaustion may have closed the other person off. They appear to turn down support or hear neutral remarks as criticism; strain is the likelier explanation, so try not to take it as a judgment of you.
other.zh: 对方可能已经筋疲力尽，把自己封闭起来，表现为推开帮助，或把平常的话听成批评；这更像是压力使然，不必当成对你的评判。

external.en: The pressure that put you on guard may have largely eased, even if no one has announced it. Help is closer than it was, and the conditions that required constant watchfulness are changing.
external.zh: 当初让你进入戒备的压力，可能已经缓和了大半，只是没人正式宣布。援手比以前更近，那些要求你时刻警惕的条件也在变化。

hopes_fears.en: You are hoping someone will tell you it is safe to rest, while fearing that the moment you lower your guard, the thing you have been dreading will arrive.
hopes_fears.zh: 你盼着有人告诉你，现在可以安心休息了；可又怕自己刚放下戒备，一直担心的那件事就找上门来。

general.en: Exhaustion or lingering paranoia signals that staying on permanent high alert has outlived its usefulness. Lower the unnecessary walls and recover.
general.zh: 权杖九逆位提示透支或草木皆兵的状态已经超出合理限度。撤下不再必要的重重防备，把恢复精力放到第一位。

love.en: In relationships, reversed Nine of Wands warns that bringing old scars into every new conversation blocks intimacy. Share your fear honestly instead of testing your partner.
love.zh: 在感情中，权杖九逆位提醒别把旧伤带进每一次新对话里筑墙自保。坦诚说出不安，比反复试探更能换来安心。

career.en: At work, burnout is knocking or defensive turf-guarding is isolating you from teammates. Ask for reinforcement and drop low-value fights.
career.zh: 在职场上，倦怠已逼近临界点，或过度护短戒备让你与团队脱节。主动开口要支援，放掉不值当的拉锯。

health.en: Depletion requires genuine recovery, not another round of grit; prioritize sleep, gentle care, and stepping away from chronic stressors.
health.zh: 在身心状态上，深度疲惫需要的是实打实的休养，而不是再咬牙硬撑；把睡眠与彻底减压设为头等大事。

spirituality.en: Letting go of the armor you needed to survive an older chapter frees you to experience safety in the present.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，慢慢卸下过往为了自保而穿上的厚重盔甲，你才能真切体会到当下的安稳与善意。

promptSpec.suitAccent: warm sunlit amber-vermilion, copper-bronze, sprouting emerald leaves, molten antique gold, luminous warm ivory
promptSpec.scene: A battle-tested Belle Epoque sentinel in a worn ochre-and-indigo coat with a crisp pale ivory cloth bandage wrapped around their forehead, standing resolutely on a twilight ridge and leaning steadily on ONE tall upright sprouting bronze-and-wood wand gripped with both hands. Directly behind the sentinel stands a neat, evenly spaced defensive palisade of EXACTLY EIGHT upright sprouting bronze-and-wood wands planted vertically in the earth—EXACTLY NINE tall wands total, every shaft and emerald-leaved tip cleanly separated and countable against the glowing amber-vermilion dusk sky. The sentinel glances watchfully over their shoulder with tired yet unbroken resolve, sculpted by warm golden rim-light against deep midnight-indigo hills.

upright sprouting bronze-and-wood wands total (1 held + 8 in palisade fence behind)

archetypeEssence.en: The weight of carrying everything alone on the final stretch—time to edit, delegate, or set down what isn't yours.
archetypeEssence.zh: 在最后一段上坡路把所有担子一人扛在肩头的沉重感——是时候做减法、托付或放下本不属于你的负担。

en: Traveler leaning forward under a heavy bundle of ten wooden wands
Ten sprouting staves carried together blocking the carrier's forward sightline
Distant settled town visible ahead across open ground showing the goal is close
Strained posture demonstrating commitment pushed past sustainable capacity
zh: 俯身前倾、怀抱十根沉重权杖艰难前行的旅人
成束遮挡前方视线的十根带叶木杖
前方开阔平地尽头依稀可见的城镇，说明终点已在视野之内
绷紧吃力的身姿，体现责任感超出合理负荷

en: Resolute traveler striding uphill at glowing amber-vermilion dusk carrying a tightly fanned bundle of ten slender sprouting wooden wands
Exactly ten distinct flowering staves with warm bronze-gold tips and tiny emerald leaves arranged cleanly in a countable fan
Warm lantern-lit hilltop town glowing ahead against deep twilight indigo
Dramatic warm dusk rim-light separating traveler, ten wands, and destination silhouette
zh: 在琥珀暮色中沿坡前行、怀抱一束整齐展开的十根发芽权杖的旅人
清晰可数的十根古铜鎏金木杖，梢头点缀细小翠叶
前方山坡顶端亮起暖黄灯火的城镇剪影
浓烈暮光勾勒出旅人、十根权杖与远方终点的明暗层次

core.en: Ten of Wands reflects genuine effort nearing completion, yet weighed down by carrying too many obligations at once. The town is already in sight—how you finish matters as much as finishing.
core.zh: 权杖十反映你离终点已经不远，但把太多责任一股脑揽在自己怀里导致视野受阻。城镇就在眼前——以怎样的方式走完最后一段，和走到终点同样重要。

message.en: Audit what you are carrying right now: the load is real, not imagined, and at least two of those wands can be delegated, deferred, or dropped.
message.zh: 现在就盘点你怀里抱着的所有担子：这份沉重是真实的，不是你想多了，其中至少有两根权杖可以转交、延后或干脆放下。

foundation.en: Saying yes to every opportunity or stepping in to rescue things piled up into today's heavy workload.
foundation.zh: 过去对每次机会都点头，或习惯性替别人兜底，层层叠成了今天的超负荷局面。

present.en: You are near the finish line, but tunnel vision from sheer workload risks burning out right before arrival.
present.zh: 你已接近冲线阶段，但过重的事务正遮住前路视野，稍不注意就会在到达前耗竭。

challenge.en: Holding every wand yourself blocks your view of the path ahead and turns a meaningful goal into a joyless chore.
challenge.zh: 把每根权杖都死死抱在自己怀里，既挡住了看路的视线，也让原本有意义的目标变成了毫无生气的苦差。

resource.en: Your endurance and follow-through are formidable—pair that grit with ruthless prioritization instead of brute force alone.
resource.zh: 你的耐力与扛事能力非常扎实——把这份韧劲配上毫不手软的主次取舍，而别只靠蛮力硬顶。

action.en: Put the bundle down for ten minutes, list everything on your plate, keep only the essentials needed to reach the gate, and hand off or drop the rest.
action.zh: 先把手里的担子放地上十分钟，把所有事项列出来：只保留抵达城门必需的核心几项，其余果断分担或砍掉。

outcome.en: Completion is within reach; once you trim excess obligations, the burden lifts cleanly into a lighter next cycle.
outcome.zh: 阶段收官近在眼前；只要肯精简多余包袱，重压很快会转化为轻装进入下一轮的踏实感。

advice.en: Asking for help or cutting scope on the final stretch is smart stewardship, not weakness.
advice.zh: 在最后冲刺段主动求助或收窄范围，是成熟的统筹能力，绝不是软弱。

hidden.en: Check whose work you are actually carrying. Some of this load may have been picked up out of habit or pride, and with your view blocked you may not see how near the end is.
hidden.zh: 核对一下，你抱着的到底是谁的活儿。其中一部分可能是出于习惯或好强才揽下的；视线被挡住的你，也可能看不到终点已经多近。

self.en: You are the one who carries it all: dependable, determined, and so used to shouldering the load that asking someone to take a piece hardly occurs to you.
self.zh: 你就是那个什么都自己扛的人：靠得住，有毅力，也太习惯肩上压着重量，以至于几乎想不到可以请人分走一些。

other.en: Their plate looks full. The other person appears overloaded and preoccupied with obligations, so any shortness or distance likely reflects workload more than their regard for you.
other.zh: 对方手上的事看起来已经堆满了：负担过重，心思都在要尽的责任上；他们的简短或疏远，反映的很可能是工作量，而不是对你的态度。

external.en: Demands from outside keep stacking up: deadlines, dependents, and responsibilities that others have left with you. The structure around you expects a lot and offers little slack.
external.zh: 外来的要求不断叠加：各种期限、需要你照顾的人，还有别人留给你的责任。你所处的环境对你期待很高，留的余地却很少。

hopes_fears.en: You hope to reach the end and prove you could carry it all, yet fear that if you put anything down, it will fall apart or people will think less of you.
hopes_fears.zh: 你希望撑到终点，证明这一切自己都扛得动；又怕只要放下任何一样，事情就会散架，或者别人会因此看轻你。

general.en: You are close to completion, yet overloaded by carrying more than one person should. Sort essentials from inherited extras so you reach the finish intact.
general.zh: 离完成只差最后一段，但你背了远超单人合理上限的重量。分清核心任务与顺手揽下的包袱，完好抵达终点。

love.en: In love, Ten of Wands shows emotional labor leaning too heavily on one side, or external stress crowding out tenderness. Name what feels heavy instead of silently enduring.
love.zh: 在感情中，权杖十显示关系里的情绪或生活照料过度压在单方肩上，或外界压力挤干了温情。直接说出哪里太沉，别默默硬撑。

career.en: At work, this is classic crunch time and scope overload. Ship the core deliverable, push back on non-critical add-ons, and delegate clearly.
career.zh: 在职场上，这是典型的冲刺期与职责过载。先保核心交付物上线，对非关键加塞说不，并明确拆解分工。

health.en: Physical tension, neck/shoulder strain, or sheer fatigue is your body flagging unsustainable output. Schedule real rest before exhaustion schedules it for you.
health.zh: 身体发紧、肩颈疲惫或持续倦怠正在提示输出超载。主动安排真正恢复，别等精力透支替你按暂停。

spirituality.en: Examine which 'duties' are actually old guilt in disguise; devotion is not measured by how much you suffer.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，权杖十邀请你审视哪些所谓责任其实是伪装的愧疚感或讨好；真正的担当从来不以自我折磨和耗竭的程度来衡量。

core.en: Ten of Wands reversed marks the turning point of putting burdens down—either relief through delegation and boundary-setting, or the crack that happens when overload is ignored too long.
core.zh: 权杖十逆位指向卸下重担的转折点——要么通过放手与交接迎来松弛，要么因长期硬撑不肯松手而出现失衡预警。

blocked.en: Refusing to delegate because 'it's faster if I just do it myself' keeps you trapped.
blocked.zh: 因为“自己顺手做更快”而拒绝托付，结果把自己锁死在重压里。

excess.en: Collapse or snapping under obligations that never should have been stacked together.
excess.zh: 在原本就不该叠在一起的任务下濒临崩溃或情绪爆发。

internalized.en: Quietly admitting to yourself that you don't want to keep carrying a borrowed dream.
internalized.zh: 内心已经承认，你其实不想再继续替别人扛这份期待。

release.en: Choosing relief: setting down unnecessary wands and walking lighter toward what truly counts.
release.zh: 主动选择松绑：把多余的权杖放到路边，轻装走向真正重要的事。

message.en: Being needed and being overloaded are not the same thing. You are allowed to put this down before you have proved that you could carry it to the end.
message.zh: 被人需要和不堪重负，不是一回事。你可以在证明“自己能扛到底”之前，就把它放下。

foundation.en: For a long time you measured your worth by how much you could carry. That belief stacked up the load, and it is also why setting any of it down has felt like failing.
foundation.zh: 很长一段时间里，你都用“能扛多少”来衡量自己的价值。担子就是这样越堆越高的，也正因如此，放下任何一件都让你觉得像失败。

present.en: Something is giving. Either you have started handing things off and feel the first relief, or the load has begun slipping in ways you did not choose.
present.zh: 有什么东西正在松动。要么你已经开始把事情交出去，尝到了头一口轻松；要么担子已经开始以你没选择的方式往下滑。

challenge.en: The difficulty is letting go itself: you keep taking tasks back, redoing what others did, or holding on until exhaustion decides for you which things get dropped.
challenge.zh: 难就难在放手本身：你总把交出去的事又接回来，把别人做过的重做一遍，或是一直硬撑，直到由疲惫替你决定丢掉哪一件。

resource.en: Relief is already available—someone or a simpler process can take part of this weight if you release control.
resource.zh: 减负的出口其实已经在手边——只要你肯交出控制权，就有人或更简化的流程能接走一部分重量。

action.en: Cancel, renegotiate, or hand off at least one heavy commitment today before fatigue forces a messy drop.
action.zh: 今天就把至少一项沉重承诺取消、重谈或交接出去，别等彻底累垮才被动失手。

outcome.en: If you keep releasing what is not yours, the pace tends to become sustainable and your view of the road clears. If you hold on to everything, the choice of what falls is likely to be made for you.
outcome.zh: 如果你继续放下不属于自己的部分，节奏会逐渐变得可以持续，前路也看得清了。如果什么都不肯松手，掉下哪一件，很可能就由不得你选。

advice.en: Stop treating strain as proof of commitment. Sort what you hold into yours, shared, and not yours at all, and return the last pile without apology.
advice.zh: 别再把吃力当作尽责的证明。把手上的事分成三类：该你的，可以分担的，根本不是你的；最后一类，不带歉意地还回去。

hidden.en: Look at what you gain from being the one who carries everything. Being indispensable can be a way of feeling secure, and you may already know which burden you no longer want.
hidden.zh: 看看“什么都由我来扛”给了你什么好处。不可或缺有时是一种获得安全感的方式；而你也许早就清楚，哪副担子你已经不想再背。

self.en: You are reaching your limit and beginning to admit it: less willing to say yes automatically, resentful of what you agreed to, and starting to imagine a lighter way of doing this.
self.zh: 你正逼近极限，也开始承认这一点：不再愿意张口就答应，对当初应下的事心生怨气，并且开始想象一种更轻松的做法。

other.en: They may be at breaking point or in the middle of offloading. The other person appears to be cancelling, handing things back, or going quiet, and limited capacity is a likelier cause than anything about you.
other.zh: 对方可能已经到了临界点，或正在卸下担子，表现为取消安排、把事情推回来，或者不怎么出声；原因更可能是他们撑不住了，而不是针对你。

external.en: Circumstances are shifting the load, with or without your say: a project ends, roles are reassigned, or help turns up. Expectations placed on you are open to renegotiation.
external.zh: 不管你有没有发话，环境都在重新分配重量：某个项目结束，分工被调整，或者有人来帮忙。别人加在你身上的期待，现在是可以重新谈的。

hopes_fears.en: Part of you hopes you can lay it all down and still be valued; another part fears that without the load you carry, people will have no reason to need you.
hopes_fears.zh: 你既希望把这一切放下之后，自己依然被看重；又担心没有了肩上的担子，别人就再没有需要你的理由。

general.en: It is time to stop equating heaviness with worth. Release what is no longer yours to carry so momentum can breathe again.
general.zh: 权杖十逆位提醒你停止把扛得越重等同于越有价值。果断把不再属于你的担子放下来，生活与工作的节奏才能重新自由呼吸。

love.en: In relationships, reversed Ten of Wands invites dropping unspoken obligations and rebalancing who holds what, bringing genuine relief.
love.zh: 在感情中，权杖十逆位鼓励放下未言明的单方妥协，重新分配彼此承担的分量，关系反而会轻松回温。

career.en: At work, drop low-leverage busywork, renegotiate unrealistic deadlines, and hand off tasks that keep you from high-impact focus.
career.zh: 在工作与事业上，果断砍掉低杠杆杂务、重谈不切实际的截止日期，把持续拖累核心产出的事务移交、自动化或明确婉拒。

health.en: Decompression is overdue—lighten the schedule and treat recovery as non-negotiable maintenance.
health.zh: 在身心状态上，减压与松绑早已到期——先给日程和待办清单做切实减法，把睡眠与休养当作不可妥协的基础维护来执行。

spirituality.en: Letting go of martyr habits opens space for genuine vitality and willing generosity.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，放下自我牺牲式的苦行惯性，允许自己轻装前行，真正的生命热情与心甘情愿的慷慨才会在内在重新流淌回来。

promptSpec.suitAccent: warm amber-vermilion dusk, burnished bronze-gold, sprouting emerald leaf highlights, deep indigo twilight
promptSpec.scene: A resolute Belle Epoque traveler in a richly textured bronze-crimson coat and indigo sash striding uphill along a winding twilight path toward a small warmly lantern-lit stone town glowing on the hilltop in the upper-right distance. Leaning slightly forward under the weight, the traveler embraces a clearly fanned, cleanly separated bundle of EXACTLY TEN slender, straight wooden wands with gleaming antique-gold finials and tiny sprouting emerald leaves along their upper ends—every single one of the TEN wands is clearly visible, distinct, and countable against the glowing amber-and-ivory dusk sky behind them. Dramatic warm sunset rim-light catches the traveler's back, coat folds, and the ten wooden wands against rich midnight-indigo foreground hills.

requiredObjects.object: distinct sprouting wooden wands in fanned bundle

promptSpec.compositionNote: Strong diagonal uphill silhouette with the TEN wands fanned cleanly against bright amber-ivory dusk sky so every wand shaft and tip separates crisply; warm sunset glow on upper right contrasts deeply with indigo foreground.

archetypeEssence.en: Eager creative curiosity—a lively messenger ready to explore, experiment, and learn by doing.
archetypeEssence.zh: 兴致勃勃的探索信使——怀揣好奇与热忱，随时准备通过亲身试水去发现新世界。

en: Youthful figure standing in a sun-warmed desert landscape with distant pyramids
One tall sprouting wooden wand held upright and examined with bright curiosity
Tunic patterned with fire salamanders symbolizing elemental passion
Feathered traveler's cap signaling free spirit and swift news
zh: 立于暖阳沙丘与远方金字塔前的朝气青年
双手扶立、正满怀好奇细细端详的一根发芽木杖
绣有火蜥蜴纹样的短袍，象征火元素热情
插着明艳羽毛的旅人帽，寓意自由灵动与好消息

en: Lively Belle Epoque youth in a golden-ochre tunic embroidered with vermilion-gold salamanders and a jaunty feathered cap
Exactly one tall sprouting bronze-and-wood wand planted upright in the warm desert sand as the Page inspects its emerald leaves with eager wonder
Golden twilight desert dunes and three small distant pyramids glowing beneath a deep starry midnight-indigo sky
Warm sunlit amber-ivory highlights illuminating the Page's bright face, feathered hat, and single flowering wand
zh: 身穿绣有朱金火蜥蜴纹样赭黄短袍、头戴羽帽的灵动美好年代少年
稳立沙地、正被侍从满眼好奇端详枝头嫩叶的唯一一根发芽古铜木杖
星夜靛蓝天幕下泛起暖金光泽的沙漠沙丘与远方金字塔
暖象牙金光勾勒出少年明朗面庞、帽羽与唯一发芽权杖的鲜活轮廓

core.en: Page of Wands brings fresh enthusiasm, encouraging news, and the itch to try something new. You don't need mastery yet—bring playful curiosity, ask bold questions, and run a small real-world experiment.
core.zh: 权杖侍从带来鲜活热情、令人振奋的新消息与跃跃欲试的探索欲。眼下不必先成为大师——带着轻松好奇大胆发问，用一次小步实战边做边学。

message.en: Follow the thread that genuinely excites you; a playful prototype or candid pitch opens a surprisingly bright door.
message.zh: 顺着那个真正让你眼前一亮的线索走下去；一次轻松试水或坦诚提议，会推开意想不到的好门。

foundation.en: A spark of curiosity, an inspiring message, or a willingness to learn from scratch set this journey in motion.
foundation.zh: 最初的一点好奇心、一条启发性的消息，或愿意从零学起的敞开态度，开启了这段旅程。

present.en: You are in discovery mode—ideas are bubbling up and fresh invitations or creative leads are ready to explore.
present.zh: 你正处在探索发现期——点子不断冒头，新的邀约与创意线索正等着你去试探。

challenge.en: The risk is getting distracted by shiny new ideas before finishing the first experiment—see that one through before chasing the next.
challenge.zh: 风险在于刚起头就被下一个新鲜念头拐跑——先把眼前的小实验跑完，再去追新的。

resource.en: Your strongest asset is infectious enthusiasm and beginner's agility; you can pivot and learn faster than rigid experts.
resource.zh: 你最强的优势是具感染力的热忱与轻盈学习力；相比固守套路的老手，你能更快试错和转身。

action.en: Sign up for the workshop, send the exploratory pitch, or spend an hour tinkering with the idea hands-on.
action.zh: 报下那门课、发出试探性合作信，或今天就花一小时亲手把点子折腾出个小样。

outcome.en: Keep following this curiosity and encouraging news, a stimulating new skill, or a lively creative opening is likely to set you onto a fresh path.
outcome.zh: 顺着这份好奇走下去，一条鼓舞人心的消息、一项令人兴奋的新技能或一个鲜活的创意契机，很可能把你带上新的轨道。

advice.en: Stay curious and travel light—treat mistakes as field notes rather than verdicts.
advice.zh: 保持好奇、轻装上阵——把试错当成田野笔记，而不是对自己的最终判决。

hidden.en: An interest you have been treating as a side curiosity may matter more than you admit. Check whether an invitation or a piece of news is already nearby, waiting for you to notice it.
hidden.zh: 一个被你当作“随便看看”的兴趣，可能比你承认的更重要。留意一下，是不是已经有一份邀请或一条消息就在附近，等你去发现。

self.en: You arrive as the keen beginner: curious, unguarded about what you do not know, and happy to try things before you are sure they will work.
self.zh: 你是以兴致勃勃的新手姿态出现的：充满好奇，不掩饰自己的不懂，也乐意在没把握之前先动手试试。

other.en: Eager and full of ideas is how they come across. The other person is likely enthusiastic about beginnings and quick to propose things, though their plans may still be at the sketch stage.
other.zh: 对方给人的感觉是很起劲，点子也多；他们大概对新开始充满热情，提议来得很快，不过这些计划可能还停留在草图阶段。

external.en: The environment rewards experiments right now: news is encouraging, people are open to fresh voices, and the stakes are low enough that trying something costs little.
external.zh: 眼下的环境对尝试很友好：传来的消息令人鼓舞，人们愿意听新面孔说话，而且成本低，试一试并不会损失什么。

hopes_fears.en: You hope this new interest will open into something you can grow with, yet fear looking like an amateur in front of people who already know the ground.
hopes_fears.zh: 你希望这个新兴趣能发展成可以陪你一起成长的东西；又怕在内行人面前，自己看起来就是个外行。

general.en: Enthusiasm, exploration, and welcome creative news light up the scene. Say yes to learning through direct experience rather than over-theorizing.
general.zh: 热情、探索欲与令人欣喜的新消息点亮当下。比起纸上谈兵，更适合通过亲身体验与小步尝试打开局面。

love.en: In love, Page of Wands brings playful flirting, lively curiosity, and refreshing spontaneity. Plan something adventurous together or enjoy getting to know someone without heavy scripts.
love.zh: 在感情中，权杖侍从带来轻快俏皮的吸引、鲜活好奇与不按套路的惊喜。一起尝试新鲜体验，享受轻松自在的靠近。

career.en: At work, this is prime energy for a new skill, creative pitch, side project, or early-stage opportunity. Volunteer to test the unfamiliar tool or idea.
career.zh: 在工作与学业上，非常适合学一项新技能、提出创意提案或试水早期机会。主动认领那个充满新鲜感的探索任务。

health.en: Try a playful new form of movement or a fresh routine that genuinely sparks your interest—enjoyment beats grim discipline right now.
health.zh: 在身心状态上，不妨尝试一种让你觉得好玩的运动或新节奏——此刻“有意思”比苦大仇深的自律更容易坚持。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, Page of Wands invites wonder and experimentation—explore a new practice with an open, unpretentious heart.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，权杖侍从邀请你带着赤子般的好奇去探索——不端架子，用敞开的心态体验新的内在功课。

core.en: Page of Wands reversed points to hesitation, unfocused energy, or a promising idea stalling because self-doubt or restlessness keeps pulling you off track.
core.zh: 权杖侍从逆位指向犹豫退缩、精力分散，或一个原本不错的点子因自我怀疑与三分钟热度而迟迟落不了地。

blocked.en: Fear of looking inexperienced is stopping you from trying the very thing you want to learn.
blocked.zh: 怕显得不专业、怕出糗，反而拦住了你去尝试自己最想学的东西。

excess.en: Restless impatience—jumping between half-started hobbies or speaking before thinking.
excess.zh: 心浮气躁——在好几个半途而废的兴趣间来回横跳，或没想清就急着表态。

internalized.en: Quietly longing for adventure while talking yourself out of every small first step.
internalized.zh: 内心明明渴望冒险与突破，嘴上却总替自己找出各种不敢迈步的理由。

release.en: Dropping three noisy distractions so one genuine curiosity can finally get your real attention.
release.zh: 果断放掉几个凑热闹的分心念头，把专注力还给那件真正吸引你的事。

message.en: Your enthusiasm is intact; what it lacks is a single place to land. Pick the idea you keep coming back to, and let the others wait.
message.zh: 你的热情并没有丢，它缺的只是一个落脚点。挑出那个你一再绕回去的念头，其余的先放一放。

foundation.en: This follows a string of beginnings without middles: courses dropped, drafts abandoned, or an idea talked about so much that the urge to actually do it wore off.
foundation.zh: 在此之前，是一连串有头无尾的开始：半途放弃的课程，丢下不管的草稿，或是一个被你讲了太多遍、反倒没了动手欲望的点子。

present.en: You are hovering at the starting line, drawn to something but stalling: waiting to feel more qualified, or switching to a newer idea each time the current one gets difficult.
present.zh: 你正在起跑线上徘徊，明明被某件事吸引，却迟迟不动：要么想等自己更够格，要么眼前这个一变难，就换一个更新的念头。

challenge.en: Scattered focus, delayed news, or lack of follow-through is turning lively potential into frustration.
challenge.zh: 注意力分散、消息迟迟未落或缺乏持续跟进，正在把原本鲜活的潜力消耗成挫败感。

resource.en: Curiosity is still alive in you, and that part cannot be faked. Your false starts have also shown you what bores you quickly, which narrows the field to what deserves a real attempt.
resource.zh: 你的好奇心还活着，而这正是装不出来的部分。那些不了了之的尝试，也让你知道了什么会很快让你厌倦，值得认真一试的范围因此缩小了。

action.en: Pick just one small curiosity, give it a seven-day test, and ignore every other shiny tangent until then.
action.zh: 只挑一个最让你动心的小方向，给它七天专注试水期，在此之前屏蔽所有其他诱惑。

outcome.en: Direction clarifies once you stop chasing novelty for its own sake and commit to one real try.
outcome.zh: 当你不再为了图新鲜而四处打转，转而认真试透一件事，清晰方向很快就会浮现。

advice.en: You don't have to be brilliant on day one—just stay with one spark long enough to see what it becomes.
advice.zh: 第一天不必完美无缺——只要肯守着一簇火苗多待一会儿，就能看见它真正长成什么样。

hidden.en: Fear of looking foolish may be passing itself off as lack of time or interest, so test that excuse. News you are waiting on may also be delayed, not denied.
hidden.zh: 看看“怕出丑”是不是正伪装成“没时间”或“没兴趣”。另外，你等的那条消息，可能只是迟到，并不是被拒绝。

self.en: You are showing up restless and unsure: enthusiastic in talk, hesitant in practice, and quick to play down an idea before anyone else gets the chance to.
self.zh: 你表现得既坐不住又没把握：说起来热情高涨，做起来迟疑不前，还总赶在别人开口之前，先把自己的想法贬低一番。

other.en: At the moment they may offer more talk than follow-through. The other person appears interested but inconsistent, and inexperience or distraction is a likelier cause than bad faith.
other.zh: 眼下，对方可能是说得多、做得少；看上去有兴趣，却不怎么稳定，原因更像是经验不足或分了心，而非没有诚意。

external.en: Encouragement from outside is thin just now: expected news is late, early feedback is mixed, and there are more distractions on offer than clear openings.
external.zh: 外界的鼓励眼下有点稀薄：等的消息迟迟不来，初期的反馈好坏参半，摆在面前的干扰比清晰的机会更多。

hopes_fears.en: You want to find the one thing that holds your interest for good, and you dread that committing to it will reveal you are less talented than you imagined.
hopes_fears.zh: 你想找到那件能让自己一直感兴趣的事；却怕真的投入进去，才发现自己并没有想象中那么有天分。

general.en: Hesitation or unfocused energy is scattering your spark. Narrow down to one doable experiment and let curiosity outrun self-consciousness.
general.zh: 权杖侍从逆位提示犹豫观望或精力发散。把注意力收回到一个切实可行的小尝试上，别让顾虑磨光了热情。

love.en: In relationships, reversed Page of Wands can mean mixed signals, flaky enthusiasm, or boredom creeping in. Bring honest presence instead of chasing novelty.
love.zh: 在感情中，权杖侍从逆位常对应态度忽冷忽热、承诺偏轻飘或新鲜感褪去后的乏味。用真诚投入取代一味图新鲜。

career.en: At work, beware half-finished drafts, delayed replies, or shiny-object syndrome. Finish one small deliverable before pitching the next.
career.zh: 在职场上，警惕虎头蛇尾、消息延误或见异思迁。先把眼下一个小交付做完，再提下一个新创意。

health.en: Restlessness or starting intense routines only to drop them days later drains morale; pick something light and repeatable.
health.zh: 在身心调理上，三分钟热度的激进打卡只会挫伤信心；选一个轻松、无负担、明天也愿意继续的小习惯。

spirituality.en: Collecting ideas without practicing them keeps growth theoretical; choose one simple daily anchor and actually live it.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，光收集概念却不践行会让成长停在纸面；挑一个最朴素的日常功课真正活出来。

promptSpec.suitAccent: warm sunlit amber-vermilion, copper-bronze, sprouting emerald leaves, molten antique gold, luminous warm ivory
promptSpec.scene: An eager, bright-eyed Belle Epoque youth standing in a sunlit twilight desert of rolling golden dunes with three small distant pyramids along the warm horizon. Wearing a tailored ochre-gold tunic embroidered with sinuous vermilion-and-gold salamanders, billowy ivory sleeves, and a jaunty cap adorned with a sweeping amber-vermilion plume, the Page stands upright holding EXACTLY ONE tall, straight sprouting bronze-and-wood wand planted in the sand before them, gazing up at its fresh emerald leaves with vivid curiosity and wonder. Crisp warm amber-ivory light illuminates the Page's face, feathered cap, and the single flowering wand against a deep starry midnight-indigo sky.

requiredObjects.object: youthful Page in salamander-embroidered tunic and feathered cap

promptSpec.compositionNote: Clean vertical silhouette of the youthful Page inspecting ONE tall golden-bronze wand against open starry desert sky; reads effortlessly at 64x96 thumbnail.

archetypeEssence.en: Bold, high-heat momentum—charging into adventure with fearless conviction and sparks flying at your heels.
archetypeEssence.zh: 炽烈果敢的冲锋之势——带着无畏信念跃马入局，所过之处火星四溅。

en: Armored Knight charging across desert dunes astride a rearing chestnut steed
One sprouting wooden wand gripped high in the right hand
Fiery red-orange plumes streaming from helmet and armor
Yellow surcoat patterned with salamanders echoing untamed fire
zh: 策动腾跃烈马驰骋沙丘的披甲骑士
右手高高擎起的一根发芽木杖
自头盔与臂甲向后烈烈飞扬的赤红羽饰
绣满火蜥蜴纹样的明黄战袍，呼应炽烈火性

en: Dashing Belle Epoque Knight in burnished bronze-gold armor and a flowing amber-vermilion salamander surcoat astride a powerful rearing chestnut steed
Exactly one sprouting bronze-and-wood wand raised high and forward in the Knight's right hand
Flame-like vermilion plumes streaming from the Knight's helm against a dramatic dusk desert of distant pyramids
Electric warm amber-vermilion key light sculpting horse, armor, and single raised wand against deep midnight-indigo sky
zh: 身披古铜鎏金铠甲与火蜥蜴纹战袍、策动昂首腾跃骏马的美好年代骑士
骑士右手向前高擎、清晰唯一的一根发芽古铜木杖
头盔上如火焰般烈烈飘扬的朱红羽饰，背景是暮色沙丘与远方金字塔
炽热琥珀主光在深邃午夜蓝天中勾勒出人马腾跃与单杖冲锋的凌厉剪影

core.en: Knight of Wands is pure kinetic courage: bold action, daring pursuit, and refusing to let hesitation cool your fire. Ride hard toward what excites you, while keeping one hand steady on the reins.
core.zh: 权杖骑士代表纯粹而炽烈的行动力：大胆出击、无畏追逐，不让犹豫把满腔热血放凉。放手奔向让你沸腾的目标，同时记得一手稳住缰绳。

message.en: Stop circling and make the bold move—decisive energy and visible daring open doors polite waiting never will.
message.zh: 别再原地打转，直接做出那个大胆动作——果断的锋芒与行动力，能撞开客气等待永远敲不开的门。

foundation.en: A fearless leap, sudden relocation, or high-energy pursuit launched this chapter at full gallop.
foundation.zh: 一次无所畏惧的纵身一跃、一场说走就走的搬迁，或一段高能的追逐，让这一章从一开始就全速奔驰。

present.en: Adrenaline, ambition, and appetite for adventure are peaking—channel this charge into one clear target.
present.zh: 眼下干劲、野心与冒险欲正处高峰——把这股冲锋势头精准对准一个明确目标。

challenge.en: Charging at full speed before checking the terrain can strike sparks that were entirely avoidable.
challenge.zh: 不看路况就全速冲锋，容易撞出原本完全可以避免的火星。

resource.en: Your strongest asset is unstoppable initiative and magnetic charisma; you rally momentum simply by moving first.
resource.zh: 你最强的优势是势不可挡的主动性与感染力；只要你率先迈步，就能把整个局面的势头带起来。

action.en: Commit boldly to the adventure—pitch the ambitious target, take the trip, or ship the daring version today.
action.zh: 果断投身这场冒险——今天就把野心勃勃的提案递出去、定下远行，或把大胆版本推上台前。

outcome.en: If you hold this bold course, your nerve is likely to be rewarded with rapid breakthroughs, an exciting change of scenery, and invigorating momentum.
outcome.zh: 若保持这份敢闯的势头，你的胆识很可能换来利落的突破、令人振奋的环境变化与强劲的推进力。

advice.en: Keep your courage high and your aim locked—passion moves mountains when it doesn't gallop off the trail.
advice.zh: 保持高昂胆气，同时死死锁住方向——热情只要不跑偏，就足以移山填海。

hidden.en: Check what the speed is for. Under the urge to charge ahead there may be a restlessness you have not named, or a wish to be gone before doubt has a chance to catch up.
hidden.zh: 看看这份急切是为了什么。一路猛冲的冲动底下，可能藏着一种你还没说清的不安分，或是想赶在疑虑追上来之前先离开。

self.en: You come in at a gallop: passionate, sure of your direction, and far more interested in doing the thing than in discussing whether it is wise.
self.zh: 你是策马冲进来的：满腔热情，对方向很笃定，比起讨论这件事明不明智，你更想直接去做。

other.en: The other person appears bold, charming, and in a hurry. They are likely to pursue what they want with real energy, and their staying power is something to observe over time.
other.zh: 对方显得大胆、有魅力，而且很急；他们很可能会带着十足的劲头去追自己想要的，至于能持续多久，需要你慢慢观察。

external.en: The pace around you is fast and the mood adventurous. Opportunities appear suddenly and favor whoever moves first, and travel or a change of scene may be part of the picture.
external.zh: 你周围的节奏很快，气氛也偏向冒险。机会说来就来，谁先动就偏向谁，其中可能还牵涉出行或换个环境。

hopes_fears.en: What you hope for is a pursuit worth giving everything to; what you fear is that if you slow down even briefly, the fire will go out and ordinary life will close back in.
hopes_fears.zh: 你渴望的是一场值得全力以赴的追逐；怕的是哪怕只稍微慢下来，这团火就会熄灭，平淡的日子重新把你围住。

general.en: Bold action, adventure, and fearless pursuit define this moment. Trust your drive, move decisively, and steer your heat toward a target worth winning.
general.zh: 大胆行动、冒险精神与无畏追逐是此刻的主旋律。相信你的冲劲，果断出击，把热度稳稳引向值得拿下的目标。

love.en: In love, Knight of Wands brings thrilling chemistry, passionate pursuit, and spontaneous romance. Enjoy the heat while checking that excitement also has room for real follow-through.
love.zh: 在感情中，权杖骑士带来令人心跳加速的吸引、热烈追求与说走就走的浪漫。尽情享受火花，同时也留意热情之后能否稳步同行。

career.en: At work, this is high-velocity execution: pitching boldly, launching into new markets, or taking on a daring stretch assignment. Pair speed with one clear checkpoint.
career.zh: 在职场上，这是高速攻坚的能量：大胆提案、开拓新市场或主动接下高难度挑战。给高速冲刺配上一个关键校准点。

health.en: High physical drive suits vigorous training and active outdoor challenge—just warm up properly and don't skip cooldowns in your rush.
health.zh: 在身心状态上，充沛体能非常适合高活力运动与户外挑战——只是冲劲再足也别省掉热身与拉伸恢复。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, Knight of Wands is fierce devotion in motion: live your convictions out loud instead of keeping them safely abstract.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，权杖骑士是行动力中的热忱：把你的信念真正活在行动与担当里，而不只是停在书本与空谈中。

core.en: Knight of Wands reversed flags impulsiveness, scattered energy, or hotheaded haste that burns bright for a day and leaves loose ends behind.
core.zh: 权杖骑士逆位指向冲动冒进、精力发散，或一时上头的急躁冲刺，热得快却在身后留下一地未收的尾。

blocked.en: Frustrated restlessness—revving the engine with nowhere clear to ride.
blocked.zh: 憋闷焦躁——引擎轰鸣不断，却还没看清究竟该往哪条路冲。

excess.en: Reckless speed, short temper, or chasing adrenaline while trampling details and people's boundaries.
excess.zh: 鲁莽疾驰、脾气一点就着，或一味追逐刺激却踩碎了细节与旁人边界。

internalized.en: Simmering impatience directed inward as self-criticism for not moving even faster.
internalized.zh: 把满腹急躁转回内部，反复苛责自己为什么还不够快。

release.en: Pulling back on the reins deliberately so wild momentum becomes steady, sustainable power.
release.zh: 有意识地轻勒缰绳，把脱缰般的冲劲收回成稳健持久的力量。

message.en: Finish what is already open before you start the next charge. Your drive is worth keeping, but it needs one direction, and urgency should cool before you reply.
message.zh: 先把已经铺开的事收尾，再发起下一轮冲锋。这股干劲值得留着，只是它需要一个方向；回应之前，也先让那股急劲凉一凉。

foundation.en: Haste set this up: a sudden exit, a commitment made in the heat of the moment, or a run of projects begun with passion and left partway.
foundation.zh: 这一切是急出来的：说走就走的抽身，一时上头许下的承诺，或是一连串热情开工、中途搁下的项目。

present.en: You are either tearing ahead without a route or stuck revving in place. Tempers are short, patience is shorter, and the unfinished pieces are piling up behind you.
present.zh: 你要么没有路线地一路猛冲，要么卡在原地空踩油门。火气不小，耐心更少，没做完的事在身后越积越多。

challenge.en: Impatience, impulsive pivots, or half-finished sprints are undercutting your credibility.
challenge.zh: 急于求成、冲动转向或屡屡半途而废的冲刺，正在悄悄损耗你的公信力。

resource.en: The drive itself is an asset once it has a single direction. You also know from experience where rushing has cost you, and you can slow your pace without losing your nerve.
resource.zh: 这股冲劲一旦只朝一个方向，本身就是本钱。你也从经历中知道，急在哪些地方让你吃过亏；放慢步子，并不会让你丢掉胆量。

action.en: Pause twenty-four hours before major commitments, finish one open sprint, and steer with a simple checklist.
action.zh: 做重大承诺前先冷静二十四小时，把手头一项未竟的冲刺收尾，用简明清单稳住节奏。

outcome.en: Friction and delays ease as soon as you trade reckless speed for disciplined direction.
outcome.zh: 只要你把鲁莽求快换成有章法的推进，沿途的磕碰与返工很快就会减少。

advice.en: Heat without steering scorches the rider—cool the rush by ten percent and you will arrive twice as fast.
advice.zh: 没有方向的烈火只会烫伤骑手——把急躁降下十分之一，你反而能快一倍抵达终点。

hidden.en: Ask whether the restlessness is covering for something else: boredom, anger you have not dealt with, or reluctance to stay with a task once it stops being exciting.
hidden.zh: 问问这份躁动是不是在替别的东西打掩护：无聊，没处理的怒气，或是事情一旦不再刺激，你就不愿继续待下去。

self.en: You are showing up impatient and combustible: quick to commit and quick to lose interest, frustrated by anything slow, and hard on yourself for not being further along.
self.zh: 你表现得急躁，一点就着：答应得快，失去兴趣也快，受不了任何慢吞吞的东西，还总怪自己怎么没走得更远。

other.en: Impulse may be driving the other person. They appear intense one day and absent the next; that looks like a pattern in how they handle excitement, so do not treat it as a measure of your worth.
other.zh: 对方可能在凭冲动行事，今天热烈，明天又不见人影；这看来是他们对待兴奋劲儿的一贯方式，别拿它来衡量自己的价值。

external.en: The situation is volatile: plans change at short notice, people act before they think, and the momentum around you could lurch in a new direction without warning.
external.zh: 局面很不稳定：计划说变就变，人们没想清楚就先行动，周围的势头随时可能毫无预兆地转向。

hopes_fears.en: You hope to break free and get moving at last, yet fear that your own impatience will wreck this the way it has wrecked things before.
hopes_fears.zh: 你希望终于能挣脱束缚、动起来；又怕自己的急性子会像以前那样，把这件事也搞砸。

general.en: Impulsiveness and scattered energy ask you to pull lightly on the reins. Focus your fire on one finishable priority instead of charging in three directions.
general.zh: 权杖骑士逆位提示冲动与精力发散，此刻需要轻勒缰绳。把火力集中在眼下一项能真正收官的要事上，别同时朝三个方向乱冲。

love.en: In relationships, reversed Knight of Wands warns against hot-and-cold passion, impatient arguments, or chasing the thrill of the chase over real reliability.
love.zh: 在感情中，权杖骑士逆位提醒警惕忽冷忽热、急躁争吵，或只贪恋追逐时的刺激却缺乏长久兑现的耐心。

career.en: At work, watch for rushed launches, reactive emails, or abandoning solid projects the moment they get routine. Follow through on what you already started.
career.zh: 在职场上，警惕仓促上线、情绪化回复，或项目一进入枯燥期就想撂挑子。把已经起跑的事稳稳跑完。

health.en: Overtraining, burnout spikes, or restless adrenaline need deliberate pacing—swap frantic bursts for steady, grounded movement.
health.zh: 在身心状态上，过度猛练或肾上腺素透支需要主动降速——把一阵风式的硬冲换成规律稳健的节奏。

spirituality.en: Patience is not the enemy of passion; learning to sit calmly with intense energy turns raw heat into lasting wisdom.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，耐心并非热情的反面；学会安稳地与强烈冲动共处，才能把原始火气炼成持久的智慧。

archetypeEssence.en: Radiant, self-possessed warmth—magnetic confidence that lights up a room without ever begging for approval.
archetypeEssence.zh: 从容耀眼的笃定暖意——无需讨好就能自然照亮全场的内在魅力与掌控力。

en: Confident Queen seated squarely on a stone throne carved with twin lions
One bright golden sunflower held openly in her left hand
One sprouting wooden wand resting upright in her right hand
Alert black cat seated calmly at her feet symbolizing intuitive independence
zh: 端坐于雕有双狮纹样石座之上的自信王后
左手舒展托起的一朵盛放金色向日葵
右手稳稳竖握的一根发芽木杖
静坐脚畔、灵动警觉的黑猫，象征直觉与独立

en: Radiant Belle Epoque Queen in a flowing golden-amber silk gown and ivory mantle seated on a sculpted stone throne carved with Art Nouveau lions and sunflowers
Exactly one upright sprouting bronze-and-wood wand held in her right hand and one luminous golden sunflower held in her left hand
One sleek, alert black cat with bright golden eyes seated calmly at her feet
Warm sunlit amber-gold aura and crown of gilded leaves glowing vividly against deep midnight-indigo twilight
zh: 身穿流光琥珀金丝绸长裙、端坐于雕有狮子与向日葵纹石座的美好年代王后
右手稳握唯一一根发芽古铜木杖，左手轻托一朵明艳金色向日葵
端坐于她脚畔、双眸泛起金光的优雅黑猫
暖金光晕与鎏金叶冠在深邃午夜蓝天中散发温暖耀眼的气场

core.en: Queen of Wands embodies vibrant self-assurance, creative magnetism, and warm courage. Own your presence completely—when you stop shrinking to make others comfortable, the right people and opportunities gravitate straight to you.
core.zh: 权杖王后象征饱满的自信、创造魅力与温暖胆识。大方舒展你的存在感——当你不再为了照顾旁人情绪而刻意收敛光芒，同频的人与机会自然会向你聚拢。

message.en: Lead with warmth and unmistakable self-belief; your authentic presence is far more persuasive than perfection.
message.zh: 带着暖意与毫不含糊的笃定走上前台；你真实鲜活的气场，比滴水不漏的完美更有说服力。

foundation.en: Hard-won self-trust and creative independence built the magnetic footing you stand on today.
foundation.zh: 一路练就的自我信任与独立底气，为你打下了如今耀眼而稳固的立足点。

present.en: You are in your element—energetic, expressive, and able to inspire others simply by being unapologetically yourself.
present.zh: 你正处在最舒展的主场状态——活力充沛、表达鲜活，只需坦荡做自己就能点燃周围人的热情。

challenge.en: Ask whether taking center stage is leaving enough room for quieter voices to contribute.
challenge.zh: 问问自己：站在舞台中央的同时，是否给更安静的声音留出了参与的空间。

resource.en: Your strongest asset is radiant charisma paired with sharp intuition; you read the room warmly and act decisively.
resource.zh: 你最强的优势是温暖的个人魅力与敏锐直觉；你既能暖场聚人，又能在关键处果断拍板。

action.en: Step into the spotlight—host the conversation, champion your creative vision, and back yourself visibly.
action.zh: 大方走入聚光灯下——主动牵头对话、旗帜鲜明地力挺你的创意愿景，为自己站台。

outcome.en: Lead with this confidence and warm influence, thriving creative momentum, and genuine admiration are likely to follow.
outcome.zh: 带着这份自信去引领，温暖的影响力、蓬勃的创作势头与发自内心的欣赏，很可能随之而来。

advice.en: Hold the sunflower and the wand together—stay generous and sunny while keeping your independence intact.
advice.zh: 把向日葵与权杖一同握稳——既保持阳光大度，也牢牢守住你不可替代的独立主见。

hidden.en: You may be underestimating your influence here; watch how often people take their cue from your mood. Check also whether a strong instinct has been set aside because you cannot yet justify it.
hidden.zh: 你可能低估了自己在这里的影响力，留意大家有多常看你的情绪行事。也看看，是否有一个强烈的直觉，只因暂时说不出道理就被你搁在了一边。

self.en: You show up fully yourself: warm, direct, at ease being looked at, and secure enough to back your own judgment without needing agreement first.
self.zh: 你是完完整整以自己的样子出现的：热情，直接，被人注视也很自在，并且有足够的底气相信自己的判断，不必先等别人点头。

other.en: They come across as confident, warm, and very much their own person. Likely generous with attention yet clear about their independence, they may respond best to directness.
other.zh: 对方给人的印象是自信、热情，很有自己的主见；他们大概不吝于关注别人，同时把独立看得很清楚，对直来直去可能最买账。

external.en: The social climate welcomes a strong presence. People want someone to bring energy and set the tone, and a capable, well-connected person nearby may offer backing.
external.zh: 周围的氛围欢迎有存在感的人。大家希望有人来带动气氛、定下基调，而身边一位能干又人脉广的人，也可能给你支持。

hopes_fears.en: You hope to be seen and admired exactly as you are, yet fear that being this visible will draw envy, or that your full presence is too much for the people you care about.
hopes_fears.zh: 你希望以本来的样子被看见、被欣赏；又怕这样显眼会招来嫉妒，或者自己全然展开的样子，会让在乎的人觉得吃不消。

general.en: Confidence, vibrancy, and inner mastery shine through here. Trust your instincts, claim your space warmly, and let bold creativity lead.
general.zh: 自信、生命力与内在掌控感在此绽放。相信你的直觉，大方占据属于你的位置，让热忱与创意自然领航。

love.en: In love, Queen of Wands brings passionate warmth, playful loyalty, and attractive self-respect. Love generously without ever shrinking your own light to keep someone close.
love.zh: 在感情中，权杖王后带来热烈温暖、坦荡忠诚与极具吸引力的自尊。大方去爱，但绝不为了留住谁而调暗自己的光。

career.en: At work, this is standout leadership, entrepreneurial flair, and personal brand magnetism. Pitch with conviction, mentor generously, and own your creative direction.
career.zh: 在职场上，她代表亮眼的领导力、创业魄力与个人影响力。带着笃定去提案，慷慨提携伙伴，稳稳主导创意方向。

health.en: Vitality thrives on joy, sunlight, and expressive movement—choose routines that make you feel strong, radiant, and thoroughly alive.
health.zh: 在身心状态上，生命力偏爱阳光、愉悦与舒展的律动——选择那些让你感到强健、明朗且神采奕奕的习惯。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, Queen of Wands unites fire with intuition: honor your gut knowing and treat creative joy as a direct expression of spirit.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，权杖王后将火焰与直觉合二为一：信任你敏锐的第六感，把鲜活的创造喜悦当作最真实的内在流露。

core.en: Queen of Wands reversed points to dimmed confidence, quiet jealousy, or overcompensating with bossiness when inner security feels rattled.
core.zh: 权杖王后逆位指向自信暂时暗淡、暗自比较生妒，或在安全感晃动时下意识用强势来遮掩不安。

blocked.en: Self-doubt or fear of outshining others is making you dim your own voice and vitality.
blocked.zh: 自我怀疑或害怕锋芒太露，让你主动压低了自己的声音与光彩。

excess.en: Demanding the spotlight, reacting sharply to rivals, or controlling the room to mask insecurity.
excess.zh: 急着抢占焦点、对竞争者反应过激，或用强势控场来遮掩内心的没底。

internalized.en: Comparing yourself silently against someone else's highlight reel until your own spark feels small.
internalized.zh: 默默拿自己的日常去对比别人的高光时刻，把原本饱满的自信比得越来越小。

release.en: Stepping out of comparison traps and reclaiming quiet, unbothered self-trust.
release.zh: 跳出横向比较的陷阱，重新找回不靠攀比也自足的沉稳自信。

message.en: Stop measuring yourself against anyone else for a while. Your confidence is low, not gone, and one thing done well for its own sake will remind you what you are good at.
message.zh: 暂时别再拿自己和任何人比。你的自信只是低落，并没有消失；专心做好一件事，就能让你想起自己擅长什么。

foundation.en: A period of comparison, or of overextending yourself, wore your confidence down. At some point you started performing warmth and energy in place of having them.
foundation.zh: 一段不断比较，或是把自己用得太满的日子，磨损了你的自信。不知从何时起，你开始表演热情和活力，而不是真的拥有它们。

present.en: Your usual spark is low. You are either holding back and keeping yourself small, or pushing harder and louder to cover the fact that you feel unsure.
present.zh: 你平日的光彩眼下有些黯淡。你要么缩着不出声，把自己放得很小；要么更用力、更大声，好盖住心里其实没底这件事。

challenge.en: Insecurity, jealousy, or burnout from always being 'on' is distorting your warmth.
challenge.zh: 内在不安、暗自较劲或长期维持高能人设带来的疲惫，正在耗损你原本的明朗暖意。

resource.en: The warmth and ability people know you for are still yours; they are resting. Time out of the spotlight lets you find out what you enjoy when no one is watching, and steady confidence grows from there.
resource.zh: 别人认识你时的那份热情和能力仍然是你的，只是在休息。离开聚光灯的这段时间，能让你发现没人看着时自己喜欢什么，稳当的自信正是从这里长出来的。

action.en: Mute comparison triggers for a week, recharge privately, and reconnect with one creative thing you love purely for yourself.
action.zh: 把引发攀比的噪音屏蔽一周，安静回血，重新做一件纯粹取悦自己的小事。

outcome.en: Authentic warmth returns quickly once you stop performing confidence and tend to your actual energy.
outcome.zh: 当你不再硬撑“永远闪耀”的外壳，转而认真照顾真实精力，由内而外的明朗很快就会回来。

advice.en: Someone else's brightness never dims yours—restore your own fire before trying to warm the whole room.
advice.zh: 别人的光亮从来不会夺走你的光芒——先把自己心里的火养暖，再去照亮全场。

hidden.en: Envy may be at work under a calm surface, so look honestly. Irritation at someone else's success could be pointing to something you want and have not allowed yourself to pursue.
hidden.zh: 看看平静的表面下，是否有嫉妒在起作用。对别人成功的那点不快，也许正指向一样你想要、却还没允许自己去追的东西。

self.en: You are second-guessing yourself in a way that is unusual for you: watching how others are doing, doubting your appeal, and swinging between withdrawing and taking over.
self.zh: 你正在反常地怀疑自己：盯着别人过得怎样，怀疑自己的吸引力，一会儿想躲开，一会儿又想把一切抓在手里。

other.en: Beneath a confident manner, the other person may be on shaky footing. They appear touchy, competitive, or controlling, which is likely self-protection and best met without escalation.
other.zh: 对方在自信的做派下，可能其实底气不足，表现为敏感易怒、爱较劲或控制欲强；这多半是自我保护，最好不要用升级对抗去回应。

external.en: The atmosphere around you breeds comparison: someone else is getting the attention, the group is cliquish or competitive, and there is little warmth on offer for now.
external.zh: 你周围的气氛容易让人互相比较：关注落在别人身上，圈子里拉帮结派或暗中较劲，眼下能得到的温暖不多。

hopes_fears.en: The hope is to feel like yourself again, bright and unbothered; the fear is that the confidence was never solid and that others have noticed the cracks.
hopes_fears.zh: 你想重新找回那个明亮、不为所动的自己；担心的是那份自信本来就不牢靠，而且别人已经看出了裂缝。

general.en: Insecurity or comparison is temporarily clouding your natural radiance. Step back from proving yourself, replenish your energy, and let genuine confidence rebuild.
general.zh: 权杖王后逆位提示不安或攀比正暂时遮住你原本的光彩。先停下向外界证明自己的冲动，安静回血，让真自信重新长出来。

love.en: In love, reversed Queen of Wands flags jealousy, possessiveness, or shrinking yourself to avoid rocking the boat. Name your insecurity kindly instead of acting it out.
love.zh: 在感情中，权杖王后逆位常对应醋意、控制欲，或为了讨好而委屈自己。温和坦白你的不安，比暗自较劲更有力量。

career.en: At work, beware imposter syndrome, turf jealousy, or micromanaging out of stress. Re-anchor in your real strengths and collaborate without keeping score.
career.zh: 在职场上，留意冒名顶替感、同行嫉妒或压力下的过度管控。回到你真正擅长的核心优势，大方协作而不必暗自较劲。

health.en: Running on charisma while ignoring fatigue drains your spark; give yourself permission to be low-key and rest without guilt.
health.zh: 在身心状态上，靠硬撑热情掩盖疲惫只会加速透支；允许自己低调歇一歇，不必为暂时不闪耀而愧疚。

spirituality.en: True sovereignty doesn't need an audience; return to quiet self-respect where your worth is already settled.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，真正的内在主权不需要观众喝彩；回到安静的自尊里，你的价值本就无需外求。

archetypeEssence.zh: 格局宏阔的统帅之火——以远见、胆魄与号召力，把大胆构想真正锻造成经久不衰的事业。
