core.en: King of Wands is mature creative leadership: seeing the whole horizon, rallying people around a bold mission, and taking full responsibility for turning vision into reality.
core.zh: 权杖国王代表成熟的创造型领导力：看得清全局远景，能围绕大胆使命凝聚人心，并坦然扛起把愿景落地的全部责任。

message.en: Step into full executive ownership—set the bold direction clearly and trust others to execute beside you.
message.zh: 站出来扛起全局主导权——把清晰宏大的方向立住，同时信任伙伴与你并肩落地。

foundation.en: Years of hands-on initiative, bold bets, and earned authority built the leadership stance you now hold.
foundation.zh: 过往一路亲自冲锋、敢于押注并兑现承诺的历练，铸就了你如今的统帅底气。

present.en: You are called to lead from the front—delegate the weeds, protect the big vision, and make the decisive call.
present.zh: 当下需要你站在前排掌舵——把琐碎细节放手分担，死死盯住大方向并做出关键拍板。

challenge.en: Watch for outrunning your team's pace, or assuming everyone sees the big picture as fast as you do.
challenge.zh: 当心跑得比团队快太多，也别默认每个人都像你一样一眼看懂全局。

resource.en: Your strongest asset is entrepreneurial vision paired with genuine nerve; people rally when you name a worthy target.
resource.zh: 你最强的资本是创业者般的格局与胆魄；只要你立出一个值得奔赴的目标，人心自然会聚拢。

action.en: Articulate the overarching vision in one crisp page, empower key lieutenants, and commit decisively to the flagship move.
action.zh: 用干净利落的一页纸把总体愿景讲透，放权给关键骨干，果断投入那一步旗舰动作。

outcome.en: Under bold, steady stewardship like this, lasting influence, successful enterprise, and respected authority are likely to grow.
outcome.zh: 在这样大胆而稳健的掌舵下，长久的影响力、成功的事业与受人敬重的威信，很可能逐步成形。

advice.en: Lead with heat and generosity—great rulers inspire ownership rather than micromanaging every flame.
advice.zh: 带着热度与胸怀去带队——真正高明的掌舵者点燃他人的主动性，而不是事事亲自盯火。

hidden.en: People may already be waiting for you to take the lead, though no one has said it. Check also whether your certainty about the direction has made you stop asking for other views.
hidden.zh: 大家可能已经在等你出面带头，只是没人说出口。也检查一下，你对方向的笃定，是否已经让你不再去听别的意见。

self.en: You take the role of the one in charge: clear about where this should go, willing to answer for the result, and inclined to lead by going first.
self.zh: 你担起的是做主的那个角色：清楚这件事该往哪里去，愿意对结果负责，也习惯用自己先上的方式来带头。

other.en: The other person carries themselves as decisive and used to authority. They are likely to state plainly what they want and expect commitment in return, and may respect people who hold their own.
other.zh: 对方的做派像是果断惯了、也说了算惯了的人；他们很可能会直白地讲出自己要什么，并期待你同样投入，也可能更敬重那些立得住的人。

external.en: The situation calls for leadership and is ready to back it. An experienced, influential figure may be shaping events, and bold, well-argued proposals are getting a hearing.
external.zh: 局面需要有人领头，也准备好了给予支持。一位有经验、有分量的人物可能正在影响事态，大胆而有理有据的提议也有人愿意听。

hopes_fears.en: You hope to build something lasting and be trusted to lead it, yet fear that the responsibility will rest on you alone and that any failure will be yours in full view.
hopes_fears.zh: 你希望建成一件能长久的事，并被信任来带领它；又怕责任只压在你一个人身上，一旦失败，就得在众目睽睽之下独自认下。

general.en: Leadership, vision, and outer mastery come to the forefront. Think like a founder, make decisive calls, and turn ambitious inspiration into durable structure.
general.zh: 领导力、远见与外在掌控力站上核心。像创始人一样思考，果断拍板，把宏大灵感锻造成稳固长久的现实成果。

love.en: In love, King of Wands brings passionate loyalty, protective warmth, and bold honesty. Show up wholeheartedly and build an exciting shared life without trying to steer every detail.
love.zh: 在感情中，权杖国王带来炽热忠诚、可靠担当与坦荡直率。全心投入、共同经营充满活力的生活，同时尊重彼此的独立空间。

career.en: At work, this is prime founder, director, and visionary strategist energy. Take ownership of the roadmap, pitch big stakeholders, and lead by decisive example.
career.zh: 在工作与事业上，这是典型的创始人、掌舵者与战略家能量。稳稳接过路线图主导权，向关键方大胆提案，以身作则带出气势。

health.en: Strong constitution and drive support ambitious physical goals—pair that vigor with disciplined recovery so leadership stamina stays sustainable.
health.zh: 在身心状态上，充沛底气足以支撑高目标的体能与状态提升——把这股劲头配上有纪律的休养，精力才能长期在线。

spirituality.en: Spiritually, King of Wands is sovereign purpose: align your willpower with service to something larger than ego.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，权杖国王代表清明的使命感：把强大的个人意志与超越小我的长远价值对齐，力量才会既猛烈又温润。

core.en: King of Wands reversed flags domineering impatience, impulsive grandstanding, or holding back from leadership when decisive stewardship is actually needed.
core.zh: 权杖国王逆位指向专断急躁、好大喜功的冲动拍板，或在需要挺身掌舵时反而缩手退让。

blocked.en: Hesitating to take command—or letting fear of failure shrink a genuinely worthy vision.
blocked.zh: 迟迟不敢接过指挥棒，或因为怕担责而把原本很有价值的愿景越缩越小。

excess.en: Bulldozing collaborators, losing patience with valid feedback, or mistaking volume for authority.
excess.zh: 强势碾压协作者、听不进合理提醒，或误把嗓门大与强硬当成真正的威信。

internalized.en: Holding yourself to impossible heroic standards until every setback feels like personal failure.
internalized.zh: 用近乎严苛的英雄标准要求自己，任何一点小挫折都让你陷入沉重的自我苛责。

release.en: Letting go of rigid ego-control so leadership becomes collaborative, calm, and sustainable.
release.zh: 松开紧绷的独断控制欲，让领导方式回归协作、沉稳与可持续。

message.en: Authority that has to be forced is already slipping. Either take up the leadership you have been avoiding, or loosen the grip that is choking it, whichever is true for you.
message.zh: 需要硬压才立得住的权威，其实已经在流失。一直回避的领导责任，就接过来；攥得太紧的那只手，就松一松；看哪一种说的是你。

foundation.en: Earlier leadership went wrong in one of two ways: decisions pushed through over objections, or a moment when you were needed in charge and held back. The effects are still playing out.
foundation.zh: 早先的带领方式在两处之一出了岔子：要么不顾反对强行拍板，要么在需要你做主的时候退了回去。它的影响至今还在延续。

present.en: Control is the live issue. You are pressing harder as people resist, or sitting on a decision that is yours to make while others wait for direction.
present.zh: 眼下的焦点是掌控。别人越抵触，你压得越紧；或者，一个本该由你做的决定被你按着不发，其他人还在等方向。

challenge.en: Impatience, top-down stubbornness, or overpromising before checking capacity is creating real friction.
challenge.zh: 急躁武断、听不进劝，或在没核对承载力前就大包大揽，正在制造实实在在的阻力。

resource.en: The vision is sound even where the delivery has been rough. You have the standing to change your approach in the open, and admitting a misjudgment tends to earn more respect than it costs.
resource.zh: 即使做法粗糙了些，这份远见本身是站得住的。你有足够的分量公开调整方式，而承认一次误判，赢得的尊重往往比失去的多。

action.en: Ask two trusted people for blunt feedback before locking the plan, and dial back urgency where patience wins better quality.
action.zh: 敲定计划前，先请两位信得过的人直言不讳地提意见；在耐心更能换来品质的环节，主动把催促降下来。

outcome.en: Authority strengthens once you replace force with listening and align ambition with realistic execution.
outcome.zh: 当你用倾听取代强压、让野心与务实执行对齐，你的号召力反而会更稳固。

advice.en: Real power never needs to shout—listen first, decide cleanly, and let steady follow-through command respect.
advice.zh: 真正的威信从来不需要大声施压——先听清、再果断拍板，用稳健兑现赢得发自内心的信服。

hidden.en: Look at whether fear of failing sits behind the forcefulness or the hesitation. Standards you would never set for anyone else may be making each setback feel like a personal indictment.
hidden.zh: 看看无论是强硬还是迟疑，背后是不是对失败的恐惧。那些你绝不会拿来要求别人的标准，可能正让每一次挫折都像是对你本人的指控。

self.en: You are showing up as either too much or too little in command: impatient and overbearing when things move slowly, or reluctant to claim a role you are well able to fill.
self.zh: 在“做主”这件事上，你不是太过就是不及：事情一慢就急躁、压人，或者明明完全胜任，却不愿站到那个位置上。

other.en: How the other person uses authority may be domineering or unpredictable. They appear impatient with disagreement and quick to overrule it, which likely says more about how they handle control than about the merit of your view.
other.zh: 对方运用权力的方式可能很强势，或者让人捉摸不定；他们看上去对不同意见没什么耐心，动辄直接否决，这反映的很可能是他们掌控局面的习惯，而不是你的看法没道理。

external.en: Leadership around you is unsteady: whoever is in charge is heavy-handed, erratic, or absent, and decisions arrive as demands with little explanation.
external.zh: 你周围的领导状况并不稳：做主的人要么手段强硬，要么反复无常，要么不见踪影，决定往往以命令的形式下来，很少解释。

hopes_fears.en: You are hoping to be the kind of leader people follow willingly, while fearing you could become the tyrant you would resent, or be exposed as unequal to the role.
hopes_fears.zh: 你希望成为那种别人心甘情愿跟随的带头人；同时又怕自己变成连自己都反感的独断者，或被人看出其实撑不起这个位置。

general.en: Impulsiveness or a domineering streak warns against forcing outcomes by sheer willpower. Temper your fire with patience and genuine listening.
general.zh: 权杖国王逆位提醒警惕冲动或过于强势的倾向，别试图仅靠硬推去强求结果。给满腔火气配上一份耐心与倾听。

love.en: In relationships, reversed King of Wands cautions against my-way-or-the-highway stubbornness or impatient temper. Share the steering wheel and listen with warmth.
love.zh: 在感情中，权杖国王逆位提醒避免“必须听我的”式固执或急躁脾气。把方向盘分一半给对方，带着暖意真正听进去。

career.en: At work, watch for dictatorial management, unrealistic timelines, or ego-driven bets. Ground ambitious targets in team reality and candid feedback.
career.zh: 在职场上，警惕一言堂、拍脑袋定死线或意气用事的豪赌。把宏大目标放回团队真实承载力与坦诚反馈里校准。

health.en: High blood pressure from chronic urgency or refusing to slow down takes a real toll; schedule deliberate decompression before stress boils over.
health.zh: 在身心状态上，长期紧绷催促与不肯慢下来会切实透支精力；在火气与压力溢出前，主动安排彻底的降压休整。

spirituality.en: True mastery includes humility—notice where the urge to direct everything is masking discomfort with uncertainty.
spirituality.zh: 在灵性层面，真正的成熟离不开谦逊——觉察自己急着掌控一切的冲动，是否在遮掩对不确定性的不安。
